fah-238.title: Pasta Soup
fah-238.chapter: Chapter 10: Fatma Abu Haty Channel Recipes
fah-238.culturalNotes: A complete, nutrient-rich meal served hot. Keeps in the fridge for two days or freeze for longer.

instructions.1: Heat the ghee and oil in a pot.
instructions.2: Add the chicken pieces and stir until golden.
instructions.3: Add the chopped onion and garlic and stir until golden.
instructions.4: Add the carrots, peas and sweetcorn and stir together.
instructions.5: Add boiling water (about 2 litres), the stock cube, salt, pepper and sugar and bring to the boil.
instructions.6: Cover and simmer over low heat until the vegetables cook.
instructions.7: In another pan, warm a teaspoon of ghee and a spoon of oil, add the pasta and stir until golden.
instructions.8: Add the browned pasta to the pot.
instructions.9: Add the celery, sweetcorn and tomato paste and stir.
instructions.10: Cover and simmer for 2 minutes until boiling.
instructions.11: Turn off the heat and rest the soup for 5–10 minutes before serving.

fah-239.title: Orzo Soup with Vegetables & Chicken
fah-239.chapter: Chapter 10: Fatma Abu Haty Channel Recipes
fah-239.culturalNotes: Serve hot with bread or as a main meal.

instructions.1: Heat the ghee in a pot over medium heat.
instructions.2: Add the chicken cubes and sear with the pepper, mastic and ground cardamom.
instructions.3: Add the chopped onion and stir until it wilts.
instructions.4: Add the peas and carrots and stir together.
instructions.5: Cover the pot and leave the vegetables for 2–3 minutes.
instructions.6: Add the courgette and potatoes and stir.
instructions.7: Add the water or broth and the stock cube and cover.
instructions.8: Cook the vegetables until done but not mushy.
instructions.9: Add the salt and the orzo and cover.
instructions.10: When the soup boils, turn off the heat.
instructions.11: Add the celery and cover for a minute.

fah-240.title: Homemade Cooking Cream
fah-240.chapter: Chapter 10: Fatma Abu Haty Channel Recipes
fah-240.culturalNotes: Keeps in the fridge for a week to ten days. Use it in sauces, soups and pasta.

instructions.1: Blend the milk, flour, ashta and sugar until smooth.
instructions.2: Pour into a pot over the heat, stirring constantly until boiling.
instructions.3: Strain through a fine sieve to remove lumps.
instructions.4: Pour into a container and refrigerate.

fah-241.title: Homemade Instant Stock Mix
fah-241.chapter: Chapter 10: Fatma Abu Haty Channel Recipes
fah-241.culturalNotes: Keep in an airtight jar in a dark spot away from heat to preserve the aroma and flavour.

instructions.1: Mix everything in a large bowl.
instructions.2: Warm over low heat, stirring for 5 minutes to drive off moisture.
instructions.3: Cool completely.
instructions.4: Grind in the spice mill until fine.
instructions.5: Store in an airtight jar in a dark spot away from heat.
instructions.6: Freeze extra in sealed bags.
instructions.7: Use a teaspoon at a time as needed.
instructions.8: Use it in soups, molokhia, sauces and other dishes.

fah-460.title: Easy Quick Bagasha
fah-460.chapter: Chapter 10: Fatma Abu Haty Channel Recipes
fah-460.culturalNotes: Serve bagasha with caramel sauce, chocolate or icing sugar. Keeps in an airtight container for up to 3 days.

instructions.1: Make the syrup: mix the sugar and water in a pot and set over the heat.
instructions.2: Leave to boil for 5 minutes.
instructions.3: Add the juice of half a lemon, a teaspoon of vanilla and 2 tablespoons of white honey.
instructions.4: Boil once more, then turn off and cool the syrup.
instructions.5: Make the dough: mix the flour, cornflour and salt in a bowl.
instructions.6: Add the oil and vanilla and mix well.
instructions.7: Add the egg and water gradually until a smooth, cohesive dough forms.
instructions.8: Knead for at least 5 minutes.
instructions.9: Cut into 3 balls and rest for 15 minutes.
instructions.10: Roll out with cornflour to about 3 mm thick.
instructions.11: Cut into small squares.
instructions.12: Fry the squares in hot oil over medium heat until golden.
instructions.13: Drain and cool.
instructions.14: Toss into the cold syrup, or dust with icing sugar, or drizzle caramel or chocolate over them.

fah-461.title: Nutella-Filled Donuts
fah-461.chapter: Chapter 10: Fatma Abu Haty Channel Recipes
fah-461.culturalNotes: Decorate with melted chocolate or any topping. The dough doesn't soak up much oil, so it's relatively light.

instructions.1: Dissolve the yeast with a spoon of sugar in warm water and leave for 10 minutes.
instructions.2: In another bowl, mix the flour with the remaining sugar, baking powder and salt.
instructions.3: Add the yogurt and mayonnaise to the flour and knead well.
instructions.4: Add the dissolved yeast and knead into a soft, elastic dough.
instructions.5: Cover and prove for 30 minutes.
instructions.6: Roll on a floured surface and cut into lemon-sized circles.
instructions.7: Cover again and rest for 5 minutes.
instructions.8: Roll pairs of circles to half a centimetre, put a little Nutella in the centre.
instructions.9: Seal well and cut with a round cutter.
instructions.10: Heat oil in a pot over medium heat and fry the donuts until golden.
instructions.11: Dust the fried donuts with icing sugar and cinnamon.

fah-462.title: Madla'a (Basbousa & Kunafa Layer Dessert)
fah-462.chapter: Chapter 10: Fatma Abu Haty Channel Recipes
fah-462.culturalNotes: The basbousa and kunafa must be completely cold before layering. Any basbousa you have works. Skip the nuts if you prefer.

instructions.1: Prepare the basbousa:
instructions.2: Toast the milk powder in a pan until golden.
instructions.3: Mix the semolina with the dry ingredients: salt, baking powder and coconut.
instructions.4: Add the warm ghee or oil and stir until it feels like damp sand.
instructions.5: Add the milk and white honey and stir until combined.
instructions.6: Grease a 26 cm tray with ghee and spread the basbousa mix.
instructions.7: Bake at 180°C until browned top and bottom.
instructions.8: Make the basbousa syrup by boiling the sugar and water.
instructions.9: Soak the basbousa with a third of the syrup.
instructions.10: Prepare the kunafa:
instructions.11: Mix the kunafa with the baladi ghee and icing sugar.
instructions.12: Bake until golden.
instructions.13: Soak the kunafa with the remaining quarter of the syrup.
instructions.14: Prepare the cream:
instructions.15: Whip the raw chantilly with the icing sugar and cold milk for 5–7 minutes until thick.
instructions.16: Add the ashta and mix well.
instructions.18: Spread a layer of kunafa in the tin.
instructions.20: Crumble the basbousa over the cream.
instructions.21: Add a second layer of cream.

fah-463.title: Light Om Ali
fah-463.chapter: Chapter 10: Fatma Abu Haty Channel Recipes
fah-463.culturalNotes: Day-old filo works perfectly here. Serve hot or cold.

instructions.1: Spread two filo sheets, cut and arrange in a tray.
instructions.2: Drizzle the ghee over the filo.
instructions.3: Bake at 180°C for 20 minutes until golden.
instructions.4: Mix the milk with the sugar and vanilla well.
instructions.5: Pour the milk mix over the tray out of the oven.
instructions.6: Decorate with nuts, raisins, coconut and caramel sauce.
instructions.7: Serve hot.

fah-464.title: Basbousa with Water
fah-464.chapter: Chapter 10: Fatma Abu Haty Channel Recipes
fah-464.culturalNotes: Top with nuts to decorate. Serve with ice cream or ashta for a better taste.

instructions.1: Mix the half cup of sugar with 3 tablespoons of water and 2 of white honey or glucose over the heat until golden.
instructions.2: Add half a cup of ghee and a cup of water and stir until the sugar dissolves.
instructions.3: Take off the heat and set aside.
instructions.4: Toast 2 tablespoons of milk powder until golden and take off.
instructions.5: Add the 2 cups of semolina, quarter teaspoon of baking powder, a tablespoon of plain flour and 2 tablespoons of coconut and mix well.
instructions.6: Add the prepared syrup mix and stir until combined.
instructions.7: Pour into a size-28 tray greased with ghee or tahini and level.
instructions.8: Bake at 180°C for 30 minutes until golden.
instructions.9: Separately, boil 1½ cups of sugar with 1½ cups of water over low heat.
instructions.10: Add a tablespoon of ghee to the syrup and mix well.
instructions.11: Pour the hot syrup over the basbousa straight out of the oven and let it absorb.
instructions.12: Cut into pieces and serve hot or cold.
instructions.13: Top with nuts to decorate if you like.

fah-465.title: Caramelised Basbousa
fah-465.chapter: Chapter 10: Fatma Abu Haty Channel Recipes
fah-465.culturalNotes: Use coarse or medium semolina for the right texture. Stir rather than knead. Grease the tray with tahini and ghee for a nice taste and colour. The oven must be hot. Pour the hot syrup on the basbousa straight from the oven.

instructions.1: Warm a cup of sugar in a pan over low heat with two spoons of water until it dissolves.
instructions.2: Stir with a wooden spoon until golden.
instructions.3: Add two spoons of white honey and mix well.
instructions.4: Add a cup of ghee, 1½ cups of boiling water and a pinch of vanilla and mix.
instructions.5: Add 4 cups of semolina, 3 tablespoons of coconut, half a cup of milk powder, 2 tablespoons of plain flour and a quarter teaspoon of baking powder and mix well.
instructions.6: Grease a 40×50 cm tray with a spoon each of ghee and tahini.
instructions.7: Spread the mixture in the tray and level with a spoon.
instructions.8: Bake in a preheated 200°C oven for 30 minutes until golden.
instructions.9: Make the syrup by simmering 3 cups of sugar with 3 cups of water until dissolved.
instructions.10: Add a tablespoon of ghee to the syrup and mix well.
instructions.11: Pour the hot syrup over the basbousa straight out of the oven.
instructions.12: Cool for two to three hours — or an hour in the fridge — before cutting.

fah-466.title: Eid Biscuits
fah-466.chapter: Chapter 10: Fatma Abu Haty Channel Recipes
fah-466.culturalNotes: Add apricot and cherry jam on the round biscuits for decoration and extra taste. Keeps in an airtight container for up to a week.

instructions.1: Beat the icing sugar and butter until white and creamy.
instructions.2: Add the eggs one at a time, beating until absorbed.
instructions.3: Add the vanilla and milk and mix well.
instructions.4: In another bowl, mix the flour, salt and baking powder.
instructions.5: Add the dry mix to the wet and fold gently until combined.
instructions.6: Cover and refrigerate for 15 minutes.
instructions.7: Shape with a piping bag or by hand.
instructions.8: Lay on an oiled tray.
instructions.9: Bake in a preheated 170°C oven.
instructions.10: Bake for 15 minutes or until golden.
instructions.11: Cool before serving.

fah-467.title: Orange & Ammonia Eid Biscuits
fah-467.chapter: Chapter 10: Fatma Abu Haty Channel Recipes
fah-467.culturalNotes: Store in a sealed tin away from moisture to keep them crisp. Shape with a cloth piping bag or a biscuit press.

instructions.1: Beat the ghee in the mixer until creamy.
instructions.2: Add the sifted icing sugar and beat for 4–5 minutes until creamy.
instructions.3: Add the eggs one at a time, beating well after each.
instructions.4: Add the orange vanilla, salt and baking powder and stir.
instructions.5: Add the milk with the baker's ammonia and stir well.
instructions.6: Add the sifted flour and cornflour and stir until combined.
instructions.7: Knead the dough by hand until soft.
instructions.8: Oil the baking tray and set the dough on it.
instructions.9: Bake at 180°C for 15 minutes.
instructions.10: Cool before serving.

fah-468.title: Blender Eid Biscuits
fah-468.chapter: Chapter 10: Fatma Abu Haty Channel Recipes
fah-468.culturalNotes: Use orange zest and juice instead of milk for an orange flavour. Shape however you like. Keeps in an airtight container for a week.

instructions.1: Blend the warm milk and oil.
instructions.2: Add the eggs and blend well.
instructions.3: Add the sugar, cornflour, baking powder, vanilla and vinegar and blend for 5 minutes until the sugar dissolves.
instructions.4: Mix the flour, baking powder, cornflour and salt in a separate bowl.
instructions.5: Add the liquids to the flour mix and knead until the dough comes together.
instructions.6: Shape as you like.
instructions.7: Lay on an oiled tray.
instructions.8: Bake at 170°C for 10 minutes until golden.

fah-469.title: Chocolate Biscuits
fah-469.chapter: Chapter 10: Fatma Abu Haty Channel Recipes
fah-469.culturalNotes: The ghee must be very cold before kneading. Use kahk/biscuit flour for the best result. Bake on the middle shelf for even cooking. Coat in chocolate for Eid.

instructions.1: Beat the cold ghee with the sifted icing sugar for 5 minutes until creamy.
instructions.2: Add the eggs gradually while beating until absorbed.
instructions.3: Add the liquid vanilla and milk and mix well.
instructions.4: In another bowl, mix the flour, cornflour, baking powder, bicarbonate and salt.
instructions.5: Add the flour mix gradually to the ghee mix, folding gently with fingertips.
instructions.6: Mix half the dough with cocoa, oil and milk for the chocolate dough.
instructions.7: Lightly oil the tray and shape circles with space between them.
instructions.8: Bake at 170°C for 17 minutes or until golden.
instructions.9: Cool completely before lifting off the tray.

fah-470.title: Plain & Chocolate Biscuits
fah-470.chapter: Chapter 10: Fatma Abu Haty Channel Recipes
fah-470.culturalNotes: The ghee must be very cold for best results. Decorate with melted chocolate once cooled.

instructions.1: Beat the cold ghee with the sifted icing sugar for 5 minutes until creamy and foamy.
instructions.2: Add the eggs gradually while beating until absorbed.
instructions.3: Add the liquid vanilla and milk and mix well.
instructions.4: In another bowl, mix the flour, cornflour, baking powder, bicarbonate and salt.
instructions.5: Add the flour mix gradually, folding gently by hand until the dough comes together.
instructions.6: Take half the dough and mix in the cocoa, oil and milk.
instructions.7: Lightly oil the tray and space the pieces on it.
instructions.8: Bake at 170°C for 17 minutes or until golden.
instructions.9: Cool completely before lifting off the tray.

fah-471.title: Filo Baklawa & Chocolate Filo Fans
fah-471.chapter: Chapter 10: Fatma Abu Haty Channel Recipes
fah-471.culturalNotes: Any crushed nuts work. Keeps in an airtight container for up to 3 days.

instructions.1: Toast the fine coconut until golden.
instructions.2: Take off and turn onto a plate.
instructions.3: Add the crushed nuts, 3 tablespoons of sugar and a teaspoon of cinnamon and mix well.
instructions.4: Take two filo sheets, brush with ghee, spread the filling and fold into thirds.
instructions.5: Roll into a log or spiral.
instructions.6: Repeat for all the filo.
instructions.7: Lay in a ghee-greased tray and brush with ghee.
instructions.8: Bake at 200°C for 20 minutes until golden.
instructions.9: For the fans: halve a sheet then quarter it, brush with ghee and fold.
instructions.10: Shape into a fan and brush with ghee.
instructions.11: Set on a greased tray and brush with ghee.
instructions.12: Bake at 200°C for 20 minutes until golden.
instructions.13: Make the soak: mix a cup of hot milk with a cup of condensed milk.
instructions.14: Soak the baklawa straight out of the oven.
instructions.15: Drizzle honey over the hot fans.
instructions.16: Dip the fan tips in chocolate then crushed nuts.

fah-472.title: Fake-Pistachio Baklawa
fah-472.chapter: Chapter 10: Fatma Abu Haty Channel Recipes
fah-472.culturalNotes: The filling keeps in a jar in the fridge for later. Serve with coffee or tea.

instructions.1: Make the filling: blitz the toasted peanuts in the processor with the sugar, pistachios, ghee and green colouring until combined.
instructions.2: Heat the oven to 180°C.
instructions.3: Spread the filling in an aluminium tray and warm in the oven for 5 minutes.
instructions.4: Prepare the pastry: cut the filo to the tray's size. Mix the ghee with the baking powder.
instructions.5: Layer filo in the tray, brushing each sheet with the ghee mix, to half the filo.
instructions.6: Spread the filling evenly over the last layer.
instructions.7: Finish the second half of the filo, brushing each sheet.
instructions.8: Cut the baklawa into your preferred shapes (squares or rectangles).
instructions.9: Bake at 180°C until golden top and bottom.
instructions.10: Make the syrup: boil a cup of sugar with 1½ cups of water, add lemon juice, boil 2–3 minutes, add two spoons of white honey and cool.
instructions.11: Soak the baklawa with the cold syrup straight out of the oven.

fah-473.title: Cream Baklawa
fah-473.chapter: Chapter 10: Fatma Abu Haty Channel Recipes
fah-473.culturalNotes: Almonds or pistachios work too. Store in an airtight container in the fridge.

instructions.1: Mix 3 cups of milk with 3 tablespoons of cornflour in a pot.
instructions.2: Heat, stirring constantly, until thick.
instructions.3: Add the tin of ashta and stir well.
instructions.4: Cool, then refrigerate.
instructions.5: Halve a filo sheet and brush with ghee.
instructions.6: Put a tablespoon of filling in the centre and spread evenly.
instructions.7: Fold the sides in and roll up.
instructions.8: Set the roll on a ghee-greased tray.
instructions.9: Repeat for all the sheets.
instructions.10: Brush the rolls lightly with ghee.
instructions.11: Bake at 200°C for 20 minutes until golden.
instructions.12: Out of the oven, drizzle honey or kunafa syrup to taste.

fah-474.title: Kunafa Baklawa
fah-474.chapter: Chapter 10: Fatma Abu Haty Channel Recipes
fah-474.culturalNotes: Any nuts work. Keeps in the fridge for up to 3 days.

instructions.1: Mix the kunafa with the melted ghee and icing sugar well.
instructions.2: Halve a filo sheet lengthways.
instructions.3: Take two filo sheets and lay a little kunafa and nuts on them.
instructions.4: Roll the filling up into a log.
instructions.5: Coil the roll into a rose shape.
instructions.6: Arrange the roses on a ghee-greased tray.
instructions.7: Brush them with a little ghee.
instructions.8: Bake at 180°C for 20 minutes until browned.
instructions.9: Sprinkle a cup of milk over the baklawa out of the oven.
instructions.10: Soak with honey or cold syrup.

fah-475.title: Kunafa & Nut Baklawa
fah-475.chapter: Chapter 10: Fatma Abu Haty Channel Recipes
fah-475.culturalNotes: Any nuts work. Add more sugar to the syrup for a sweeter baklawa.

instructions.1: Snip the kunafa small with scissors, or freeze and crumble it.
instructions.2: Add a quarter cup of ghee and rub it in until the kunafa absorbs it all.
instructions.3: Spread in the oven tray, stirring occasionally until browned.
instructions.4: Turn onto a plate.
instructions.5: Mix the nuts and raisins into the browned kunafa.
instructions.6: Cut the filo into half sheets.
instructions.7: Brush half a sheet with ghee and fold the other half over it.
instructions.8: Put the filling in the centre and roll up well.
instructions.9: Repeat until everything's used.
instructions.10: Lay the rolls spaced apart on a greased tray.
instructions.11: Score the filo with a hot knife into small pieces.
instructions.12: Drizzle the remaining ghee over the top.
instructions.13: Bake at 200°C until browned.
instructions.14: Take out and pour a cup of syrup over them.

fah-476.title: Turkish Twisted Pistachio Baklawa
fah-476.chapter: Chapter 10: Fatma Abu Haty Channel Recipes
fah-476.culturalNotes: Any nuts can replace the Aleppo pistachios. Keeps in an airtight container for up to 5 days.

instructions.1: Make the syrup: dissolve 2 cups of sugar in 1½ cups of water over the heat.
instructions.2: Add the juice of half a lemon and simmer on low for 7 minutes until medium-thick.
instructions.3: Take off and cool.
instructions.4: Boil the pistachios in water for 5 minutes, then take off.
instructions.5: Peel immediately. Cool, then toast on low until crisp.
instructions.6: Chop in the processor.
instructions.7: Prepare the baklawa: cut the filo into round pieces and butter each.
instructions.8: Put the pistachio filling in the centre, roll up and pinch the ends.
instructions.9: Arrange on an oiled tray. Halve each piece.
instructions.10: Brush the tops with butter.
instructions.11: Bake at 180–200°C for 15–20 minutes until golden.
instructions.12: Pour the cold syrup over them out of the oven.
instructions.13: Cool slightly before serving.

fah-477.title: Baklawa & Basbousa
fah-477.chapter: Chapter 10: Fatma Abu Haty Channel Recipes
fah-477.culturalNotes: White lemon juice can replace the syrup. Keeps in the fridge for up to 3 days.

instructions.1: Mix the semolina with the coconut well.
instructions.2: Set aside.
instructions.3: Heat the oven to 180°C.
instructions.4: Grease a tray with ghee or butter.
instructions.5: Take two filo sheets and brush with ghee.
instructions.6: Sprinkle the semolina-coconut mix over them.
instructions.7: Crimp the two sheets into shape.
instructions.8: Repeat until the batch is done.
instructions.9: Sprinkle sugar and butter or ghee on top.
instructions.10: Mix the milk, sugar, eggs, vanilla and chantilly and stir well.
instructions.11: Pour the liquid mix over the baklawa.
instructions.12: Bake on the middle shelf until cooked and browned.
instructions.13: Take out and soak with syrup.
instructions.14: Cut and serve.

fah-478.title: Quick Kunafa Nut Cups
fah-478.chapter: Chapter 10: Fatma Abu Haty Channel Recipes
fah-478.culturalNotes: The kunafa can go without the sauce, but it adds a special flavour. Keeps in the fridge for up to two days.

instructions.1: Heat the oven to 200°C.
instructions.2: Melt the butter or ghee into the kunafa, stirring until it absorbs it.
instructions.3: Add the icing sugar and stir again to distribute.
instructions.4: Pack the kunafa into a coffee cup, hollow out the centre.
instructions.5: Fill with nuts and raisins, then cap with more kunafa.
instructions.6: Set the cups on a buttered or oiled tray.
instructions.7: Bake for 10 minutes until golden.
instructions.8: Separately, mix the icing sugar, milk powder, butter and Kiri cube.
instructions.9: Add warm water gradually, stirring until the sauce is smooth.
instructions.10: Pour into a glass and chill.
instructions.11: Serve the kunafa hot with the cold sauce.

fah-479.title: Kunafa Nut Cups
fah-479.chapter: Chapter 10: Fatma Abu Haty Channel Recipes
fah-479.culturalNotes: The kunafa can go without the sauce, but it adds a special flavour.

instructions.1: Heat the oven to 200°C.
instructions.2: Work the butter or ghee into the kunafa until it's fully saturated.
instructions.3: Add the icing sugar and stir well.
instructions.4: Pack into a coffee cup, hollow the centre and add the nuts and raisins.
instructions.5: Cap with more kunafa.
instructions.6: Set on a buttered or oiled tray.
instructions.7: Bake until cooked.
instructions.8: Separately, mix the icing sugar, milk powder, butter and Kiri cube.
instructions.9: Add warm water gradually until the sauce is smooth.
instructions.10: Chill in a glass.
instructions.11: Serve the cooked kunafa with the sauce.

fah-480.title: Kunafa Cups with Banana & Caramel
fah-480.chapter: Chapter 10: Fatma Abu Haty Channel Recipes
fah-480.culturalNotes: Kunafa syrup can replace the white honey. Decorate with crushed pistachios or almonds.

instructions.1: Brown the kunafa in a quarter cup of ghee on the heat or in the oven.
instructions.2: Mix the ashta, Kiri, cream caramel, chantilly, milk powder, icing sugar and iced water in a bowl.
instructions.3: Beat with the electric mixer for 3 minutes until smooth.
instructions.4: Fill a piping or sandwich bag.
instructions.5: Lay a kunafa layer in the serving moulds.
instructions.6: Add a cream layer.
instructions.7: Add banana slices.
instructions.8: Add another cream layer.
instructions.9: Top with caramel sauce.
instructions.10: Decorate to taste.

fah-481.title: Luxury Petit Four with Ghee
fah-481.chapter: Chapter 10: Fatma Abu Haty Channel Recipes
fah-481.culturalNotes: The ghee must be very firm and the kitchen cool. Cream the sugar and ghee well for a crumbly texture. Bake at 170°C on the middle shelf. Keeps in a sealed tin in the fridge.

instructions.1: Beat the ghee and icing sugar with the electric whisk for about 5 minutes until creamy.
instructions.2: Add the eggs one at a time, mixing well after each.
instructions.3: Add the vanilla and salt and mix well.
instructions.4: Sift the flour in gradually and fold gently until a dough forms.
instructions.5: Pipe the petit fours onto a greased tray or baking paper.
instructions.6: Bake at 170°C for 15 minutes until golden.
instructions.7: Take out and cool.
instructions.8: For chocolate petit fours, mix ghee into the sifted cocoa and shape the same way.
instructions.9: Sandwich pairs with a dot of apricot jam.
instructions.10: Dip in white or dark chocolate and decorate with crushed peanuts.
instructions.11: Cool completely, then store in a sealed tin in the fridge.

fah-482.title: Fruit Torta
fah-482.chapter: Chapter 10: Fatma Abu Haty Channel Recipes
fah-482.culturalNotes: Any favourite fruit works for decorating, plus crushed nuts. Keeps in the fridge for two days.

instructions.1: Mix the flour, cocoa, sugar, salt and baking powder in a bowl.
instructions.2: Separate the eggs. Whip the whites with the vinegar and vanilla to meringue.
instructions.3: Beat the yolks with the sugar until creamy.
instructions.4: Add the oil gradually to the yolks, beating well.
instructions.5: Add the flour gradually to the yolk mix while stirring.
instructions.6: Fold the whites gently into the batter.
instructions.7: Pour into buttered, floured cake trays.
instructions.8: Bake at 180°C for 30 minutes.
instructions.9: Take out and cool.
instructions.10: Split the cake in half with a skewer line.
instructions.11: Soak with the compote syrup or sugar water.
instructions.12: Whip the chantilly, whipping cream and icing sugar well.
instructions.13: Spread cream on one half and add the chopped fruit.
instructions.14: Top with the other half and coat the top and sides with cream.
instructions.15: Decorate with fruit and grated chocolate.
instructions.16: Finish coating with cream, fruit and chocolate.
instructions.17: Glaze the fruit with the glaze jelly.
instructions.18: Chill for an hour before serving.

fah-483.title: Budget Gâteau
fah-483.chapter: Chapter 10: Fatma Abu Haty Channel Recipes
fah-483.culturalNotes: Serve with a cup of coffee. Any nuts work.

instructions.1: Break the biscuits or pulse them in the processor — don't powder them fully.
instructions.2: Add the cocoa and icing sugar and mix with the biscuits.
instructions.3: Add the crushed peanuts, butter and vanilla and mix well.
instructions.4: Add the milk and mix until shapeable.
instructions.5: Shape into a log, wrap in plastic and refrigerate 3–4 hours until firm.
instructions.6: Slice about 1 cm thick.
instructions.7: Dip the slices in melted white or milk chocolate and top with walnuts or peanuts.
instructions.8: Chill for 15 minutes before serving.

fah-484.title: Gâteau Château
fah-484.chapter: Chapter 10: Fatma Abu Haty Channel Recipes
fah-484.culturalNotes: Any dried fruit or nuts for decoration. Keeps in the fridge for up to 3 days.

instructions.1: Beat the sugar with two-thirds of a cup of hot milk until dissolved.
instructions.2: Add the cocoa and mix well.
instructions.3: Add the oil and mix well.
instructions.4: Add the eggs one at a time, beating continuously.
instructions.5: Add the flour, baking powder, vanilla and salt and stir well.
instructions.6: Sift the flour and baking powder into the mix.
instructions.7: Pour into a buttered, floured rectangular tray.
instructions.8: Bake at 180°C for 30 minutes.
instructions.9: Cool the cake completely.
instructions.10: Split in half and layer chantilly between the halves.
instructions.11: Soak with a milk-sugar-cocoa mix.
instructions.12: Decorate with nuts, cherries and grated chocolate.
instructions.13: Serve cold.

fah-485.title: Sweet Filo with Custard & Jam
fah-485.chapter: Chapter 10: Fatma Abu Haty Channel Recipes
fah-485.culturalNotes: Dust with icing sugar or crushed biscuits on serving for extra taste.

instructions.1: Take two filo sheets, cut to shape and roll into roses.
instructions.2: Arrange the roses on a ghee-greased tray.
instructions.3: Make the custard mix: combine the custard or cornflour with the yogurt, milk, vanilla, melted butter and icing sugar.
instructions.4: Stir until combined.
instructions.5: Pour over the roses.
instructions.6: Distribute evenly.
instructions.7: Dot each rose with a spoon of strawberry jam.
instructions.8: Bake at 180°C for 20 minutes until browned.
instructions.9: Serve hot or cold.

fah-486.title: Cream Baklawa Filling
fah-486.chapter: Chapter 10: Fatma Abu Haty Channel Recipes
fah-486.culturalNotes: The cream must be cold before filling so it doesn't leak. Saffron can go in the cream or on top.

instructions.1: Mix the 3 cups of milk with the 3 tablespoons of cornflour while cold.
instructions.2: Heat until it thickens.
instructions.3: Add a tablespoon of ashta or half a cup of dairy cream and stir.
instructions.4: Take off and cool.
instructions.5: Cut the filo into squares.
instructions.6: Put the cream in the centre of each square and seal well.
instructions.7: Drizzle hot ghee over them and leave 10 minutes to absorb.
instructions.8: Bake at 200°C for 10 minutes until crisp.
instructions.9: Soak with white honey or cold syrup.
instructions.10: Decorate with pistachios, rose petals and saffron.

fah-487.title: Mawlid Sweets (Malban, Domiya & Rope Candy)
fah-487.chapter: Chapter 10: Fatma Abu Haty Channel Recipes
fah-487.culturalNotes: Orange-blossom water can replace the vanilla. Oil the tray well so the malban doesn't stick.

instructions.1: Put 1½ kilos of sugar in a pot with half the water (about 750 ml) and stir well.
instructions.2: Add the glucose syrup and stir until dissolved.
instructions.3: Separately, mix the cornflour with the rest of the water.
instructions.4: Dissolve the citric acid in two spoons of water.
instructions.5: Dissolve the gelatin in half a cup of water.
instructions.6: Once the sugar and glucose boil, add the cornflour mix and stir.
instructions.7: Keep stirring over medium heat for two hours until cohesive and translucent.
instructions.8: Add the vanilla and stir.
instructions.9: Pour half the malban into an oiled tray and scatter nuts on top.
instructions.10: Colour the rest red, mix and pour over.
instructions.11: Cool for at least 6 hours or overnight.
instructions.12: Cut into shapes and serve.
instructions.13: For the rope: dip walnuts in the hot malban and hang on a stick to set.
instructions.14: Roll the rope in cornflour so it doesn't stick.
instructions.15: Serve the rope, malban and domiya on a platter.

fah-488.title: Tahini Halawa
fah-488.chapter: Chapter 10: Fatma Abu Haty Channel Recipes
fah-488.culturalNotes: The sesame and flour should go light beige before mixing in. Press the halawa firmly for a clean shape. Add nuts to taste.

instructions.1: Toast the sesame in a dry pan over low heat until light beige.
instructions.2: Add the flour to the same pan and toast until light beige.
instructions.3: Blend the toasted sesame with the oil and salt until smooth.
instructions.4: Add the toasted flour and blend into tahini.
instructions.5: Sift the milk powder and icing sugar together.
instructions.6: Add the tahini and vanilla and mix well.
instructions.7: Test a piece of the mixture — it should hold together.
instructions.8: Add nuts to taste.
instructions.9: Press the halawa firmly into a tray.
instructions.10: Mix cocoa into a third for chocolate halawa.
instructions.11: Refrigerate overnight.
instructions.12: Cut into small pieces to serve.

fah-489.title: Sweet Potato Dessert with Cream Caramel
fah-489.chapter: Chapter 10: Fatma Abu Haty Channel Recipes
fah-489.culturalNotes: Serve cold or warm. Ground pistachios make a pretty garnish.

instructions.1: Peel, wash and grate the sweet potatoes.
instructions.2: Spread a spoon of butter or ghee in a Pyrex dish.
instructions.3: Scatter the rusks or semolina over the butter.
instructions.4: Add the grated sweet potato with a pinch of cinnamon and a quarter cup of sugar and mix.
instructions.5: Bake on the middle shelf for 15 minutes.
instructions.6: Meanwhile, heat 3 cups of milk with the 2 cream-caramel packs until boiling.
instructions.7: Pour the cream caramel over the cooked sweet potato.
instructions.8: Cool, then refrigerate until set.
instructions.9: Cut and decorate with the fancy caramel.

fah-490.title: Homsiyya (Chickpea Brittle)
fah-490.chapter: Chapter 10: Fatma Abu Haty Channel Recipes
fah-490.culturalNotes: Any nuts work — almonds, hazelnuts, walnuts. Warm the nuts before adding the syrup to avoid moisture. Cut while warm or it hardens.

instructions.1: Put the sugar and cup of water in a pot over medium heat, stirring until dissolved.
instructions.2: Let it boil, then add the lemon juice, salt and vanilla and stir well.
instructions.3: Leave until it thickens and foams on top.
instructions.4: Add the white honey or glucose and stir until light golden.
instructions.5: Add the bicarbonate, stir fast and turn off the heat.
instructions.6: Warm the chickpeas in a pan or the oven, then turn into an oiled bowl.
instructions.7: Add a cup of syrup, stir fast and spread in an oiled tray to the thickness you want.
instructions.8: Cool slightly, then cut to size.
instructions.9: Repeat for the peanuts and sesame.

fah-491.title: Date Pops (Nut-Stuffed, Chocolate-Coated Dates)
fah-491.chapter: Chapter 10: Fatma Abu Haty Channel Recipes
fah-491.culturalNotes: Any nuts work. Keeps in the freezer for up to two weeks.

instructions.1: Wash the dates and dry them.
instructions.2: Slit them and remove the pits carefully.
instructions.3: Fill with toasted, salted nuts to taste.
instructions.4: Close the dates so they look unopened.
instructions.5: Melt the chocolate in a bain-marie until smooth.
instructions.6: Dip each date and let it drain.
instructions.7: Set on a rack lined with baking paper to shed the excess.
instructions.8: Freeze for 10 minutes until the chocolate sets.
instructions.9: Serve cold, coated in chocolate.

fah-492.title: Rice Pudding with Kunafa
fah-492.chapter: Chapter 10: Fatma Abu Haty Channel Recipes
fah-492.culturalNotes: Serve in a big bowl or small cups for elegance. Keeps in the fridge for up to 24 hours.

instructions.1: Wash the rice, soak 10 minutes and drain.
instructions.2: Add it to the milk in a pot, stirring for 5 minutes.
instructions.3: Cover and simmer for an hour.
instructions.4: Back on the heat, add the ashta and half a cup of sugar and stir.
instructions.5: Add a teaspoon of vanilla and stir.
instructions.6: Separately, mix a cup of cold milk with a teaspoon of cornflour and 2 tablespoons of chantilly.
instructions.7: Add the cornflour mix to the rice pudding and stir on low for 5 minutes.
instructions.8: In a small pot, caramelise a cup of sugar with a small cup of water until golden.
instructions.9: Add the ashta and butter to the caramel and stir until smooth.
instructions.10: Warm the kunafa in the oven with 3 tablespoons of ghee, then add 2–3 tablespoons of honey or thick syrup and mix.
instructions.11: In a big bowl, layer kunafa then rice pudding, repeating to the end.
instructions.12: Drizzle caramel sauce over the last layer.
instructions.13: Decorate with Lotus-biscuit pieces.
instructions.14: Cool before serving.

fah-493.title: Raffaello Balls
fah-493.chapter: Chapter 10: Fatma Abu Haty Channel Recipes
fah-493.culturalNotes: Fresh coconut gives the best taste. Any chocolate works. Keeps in the fridge for up to a week.

instructions.1: Mix the fine coconut with the condensed milk in a bowl.
instructions.2: Add 3 tablespoons of white chocolate and mix until combined.
instructions.3: Cover with plastic and shape small balls, stuffing some with almonds.
instructions.4: Dip in white or dark chocolate and dry on baking paper.
instructions.5: Decorate with sprinkles or coconut.
instructions.6: Chill for 10 minutes to set.
instructions.7: Or press flat, cut with a knife, coat in chocolate and set on baking paper.

fah-494.title: Apple Cake Roll
fah-494.chapter: Chapter 10: Fatma Abu Haty Channel Recipes
fah-494.culturalNotes: Dust with sugar or drizzle caramel when serving.

instructions.1: Prepare the filling:
instructions.2: Peel the green apples and slice thinly.
instructions.3: Put them in a pan with a cup of sugar, a spoon of cinnamon and 2 of butter.
instructions.4: Cook over medium heat until soft and caramelised.
instructions.5: Take off and cool.
instructions.6: Prepare the cake:
instructions.7: Mix the flour, sugar, baking powder, salt and vanilla in a bowl.
instructions.8: Add the eggs and milk and mix until smooth.
instructions.9: Bake the cake:
instructions.10: Heat the oven to 170°C.
instructions.11: Pour into a buttered, floured rectangular tray.
instructions.12: Bake for 10–15 minutes until golden.
instructions.13: Assemble the roll:
instructions.14: Cool slightly out of the oven.
instructions.15: Turn onto clean baking paper and peel off the lining.
instructions.17: Roll gently with the paper's help.
instructions.18: Refrigerate 3–4 hours until fully cold and firm.
instructions.20: Slice and serve with coffee or tea.

fah-495.title: Kahk Spice Blend (Reehat el-Kahk)
fah-495.chapter: Chapter 10: Fatma Abu Haty Channel Recipes
fah-495.culturalNotes: Use a teaspoon per kilo of dough. Keeps a long time in the freezer.

instructions.1: Measure out each spice at 5 g.
instructions.2: Grind them all in the mill until fine.
instructions.3: Add the 3 tablespoons of toasted sesame.
instructions.4: Mix until combined.
instructions.5: Store in an airtight container in the freezer.

fah-496.title: Sablé with Ganache
fah-496.chapter: Chapter 10: Fatma Abu Haty Channel Recipes
fah-496.culturalNotes: Keeps in an airtight container for up to a week. Try other fillings like cream or dried fruit.

instructions.1: Mix the flour and salt in a bowl.
instructions.2: Add the butter and icing sugar and beat until creamy.
instructions.3: Add the eggs and vanilla and mix well.
instructions.4: Add the flour gradually until the dough comes together.
instructions.5: Split the dough in half and work cocoa into one half.
instructions.6: Roll between baking-paper sheets and cut shapes.
instructions.7: Bake on a tray at 160°C for 20 minutes.
instructions.8: Make the ganache: boil the milk, add the grated chocolate and stir until melted.
instructions.9: Coat the sablés and leave to cool.
instructions.10: Decorate with icing sugar, nuts, jam and chocolate.

fah-497.title: Simsimiyya (Sesame Brittle)
fah-497.chapter: Chapter 10: Fatma Abu Haty Channel Recipes
fah-497.culturalNotes: Any nuts work. Toast them well first for better texture and taste. Keeps in an airtight container for up to a week.

instructions.1: Put the sugar and cup of water in a pot over medium heat, stirring until dissolved.
instructions.2: Let it boil, then add the lemon juice, salt and vanilla and stir.
instructions.3: Leave until it thickens and foams.
instructions.4: Add the white honey or glucose and stir until light golden.
instructions.5: Add the bicarbonate, stir fast and turn off the heat.
instructions.6: Pour into an oiled metal tray and spread to thickness.
instructions.7: Cool slightly, then cut to shape.
instructions.8: Repeat with the chickpeas and peanuts after toasting and mixing into the syrup.

fah-498.title: Eastern-Dessert Syrup
fah-498.chapter: Chapter 10: Fatma Abu Haty Channel Recipes
fah-498.culturalNotes: Use fine white sugar for the best result. Don't stir once the honey goes in or the sugar will crystallise.

instructions.1: Mix the sugar and water cold until the sugar dissolves completely.
instructions.2: Set over medium heat until boiling.
instructions.3: Lower the heat and boil for 10 minutes.
instructions.4: Add the lemon juice and honey or glucose and boil 2 more minutes.
instructions.5: Turn off and cool.
instructions.6: Bottle in clean bottles and refrigerate.

fah-499.title: Mango Charlotte
fah-499.chapter: Chapter 10: Fatma Abu Haty Channel Recipes
fah-499.culturalNotes: Any mango works. Tie a satin ribbon around the cake for special occasions.

instructions.1: Make the cream: beat the cream cheese with the whipping cream, chantilly, icing sugar and vanilla for 7 minutes until creamy.
instructions.2: Line ladyfingers in the base of a 26 cm cheesecake tin, pressing them down.
instructions.3: Add a cream layer, then a layer of mango cubes.
instructions.4: Add a layer of sponge cake, then more cream.
instructions.5: Repeat, pressing each layer, until everything's used.
instructions.6: Glaze the top mango layer to hold its colour and shape.
instructions.7: Chill for 3–4 hours until set.
instructions.8: Slice and serve with fresh or glacé cherries.

fah-500.title: Chocolate-Stuffed Dates with Biscuit & Nuts
fah-500.chapter: Chapter 10: Fatma Abu Haty Channel Recipes
fah-500.culturalNotes: Any biscuits and nuts work. Dust with gold dust for a festive look.

instructions.1: Mix 2 tablespoons of tahini paste with a cup of ground biscuits.
instructions.2: Add the toasted, unsalted nuts to the mix.
instructions.3: Stuff the dates with the mixture and close them.
instructions.4: Melt the chocolate and dip the stuffed dates.
instructions.5: Add a pinch of anise to the chocolate for extra flavour.
instructions.6: Arrange on baking paper.
instructions.7: Serve at Eid and any occasion.

fah-501.title: Orange Sauce
fah-501.chapter: Chapter 10: Fatma Abu Haty Channel Recipes
fah-501.culturalNotes: Use it on cake or any favourite dessert. Keeps in an airtight container in the fridge for up to 3 days.

instructions.1: Mix the orange juice with the Tang in a bowl.
instructions.2: Add the sugar, cornflour and orange zest and mix well.
instructions.3: Heat over medium until boiling.
instructions.4: Add a spoon of butter and stir until melted.
instructions.5: Simmer for 5 minutes until thickened.
instructions.6: Take off and cool before serving.

fah-502.title: Condensed-Milk Sauce
fah-502.chapter: Chapter 10: Fatma Abu Haty Channel Recipes
fah-502.culturalNotes: Use it on cakes and cinnabon or stir into drinks.

instructions.1: Mix the sugar and milk powder in a bowl.
instructions.2: Add the boiling water and stir well.
instructions.3: Add the butter and stir again.
instructions.4: Cover and blitz in the blender for a minute.
instructions.5: Blend until combined.
instructions.6: Add more water for a thinner sauce.
instructions.7: Cover and cool.
instructions.8: Stir in two spoons of cream cheese once cold.

fah-503.title: Pistachio Ghorayeba
fah-503.chapter: Chapter 10: Fatma Abu Haty Channel Recipes
fah-503.culturalNotes: The ghee should be room temperature before whipping. Mix the flour and sugar well for a smooth dough. Rest the dough 30 minutes in the fridge. Bake low so they don't dry or crack.

instructions.1: Take the ghee out of the fridge and let it reach room temperature.
instructions.2: Whip it for about a minute until soft and creamy.
instructions.3: Add the sifted icing sugar and beat for 4–5 minutes until white and creamy.
instructions.4: Add the vanilla and beat again.
instructions.5: Add the flour gradually while stirring until the dough comes together.
instructions.6: Add a little salt and mix.
instructions.7: Knead by hand until cohesive and soft.
instructions.8: Split into three parts: classic, chocolate and pistachio.
instructions.9: Mix the cocoa and ghee into the chocolate part.
instructions.10: Mix the ground pistachios into the pistachio part.
instructions.11: Chill all three for 30 minutes.
instructions.12: Shape small balls of about 10 g.
instructions.13: Space them on a lightly oiled tray.
instructions.14: Bake at 150°C for 15 minutes.
instructions.15: Cool completely before moving them.

fah-504.title: Foliyya (Peanut Brittle)
fah-504.chapter: Chapter 10: Fatma Abu Haty Channel Recipes
fah-504.culturalNotes: Any nuts work — almonds, hazelnuts, walnuts. Toast them well first. Keeps in an airtight container for up to a week.

instructions.1: Put the sugar and cup of water in a pot over medium heat, stirring until dissolved.
instructions.2: Let it boil, then add the lemon juice, salt and vanilla and stir.
instructions.3: Leave until it thickens and foams.
instructions.4: Add the white honey or glucose and stir until light golden.
instructions.5: Add the bicarbonate, stir fast and turn off the heat.
instructions.6: Pour into an oiled metal tray and spread to thickness.
instructions.7: Cool slightly, then cut to shape.
instructions.8: Repeat for the chickpeas, peanuts and sesame after toasting and mixing into the syrup.

fah-505.title: Honey Pumpkin Casserole with Nuts
fah-505.chapter: Chapter 10: Fatma Abu Haty Channel Recipes
fah-505.culturalNotes: Any nuts work. Serve with ice cream and caramel sauce for a richer taste.

instructions.1: Pick an orange pumpkin free of white spots and green veins, evenly shaped.
instructions.2: Halve, slice lengthwise and scoop out the seeds. Cut into large cubes and microwave for 4 minutes.
instructions.3: Peel the dried skin off easily after microwaving.
instructions.4: Cut into smaller cubes.
instructions.5: Simmer the pumpkin with a cup of sugar — boil high, then lower until cooked. Uncover to dry off the water.
instructions.6: Add 2 tablespoons of butter and stir.
instructions.7: Make the cream: melt 4 tablespoons of butter with 4 of flour until the flour taste cooks off. Add milk gradually, stirring. Add half a cup of sugar, a teaspoon of vanilla and the cooking cream or milk-skin cream.
instructions.8: Grease a dish with ghee and dust with ground rusks. Layer pumpkin then cream. Scatter nuts on top.
instructions.9: Bake at 200°C for 20–25 minutes until golden.
instructions.10: Cool slightly before serving — great with ice cream and caramel sauce.

fah-506.title: Mock Ashta Cream
fah-506.chapter: Chapter 10: Fatma Abu Haty Channel Recipes
fah-506.culturalNotes: Keeps in the fridge for 3–4 days. Use the drained whey in doughs for a better result.

instructions.1: Boil half a kilo of the milk, add the ashta and 4 tablespoons of milk powder and stir until blended.
instructions.2: As it starts boiling, dissolve the cornflour in a little water and pour in. Stir until creamy.
instructions.3: Boil the remaining kilo of milk in another pot with the quarter cup of vinegar. Stir until it splits and clumps.
instructions.4: Strain the solids through a fine sieve into the processor with a little ashta. Blitz until smooth and creamy.
instructions.5: Cover and cool before filling desserts or serving with white honey.

fah-507.title: Savory & Sweet Qatayef
fah-507.chapter: Chapter 10: Fatma Abu Haty Channel Recipes
fah-507.culturalNotes: The batter must rest before pouring, and cover cooked qatayef so they don't dry. Any cheeses and nuts work.

instructions.1: Mix the flour, semolina, sugar, baking powder, yeast and a pinch of salt in a bowl.
instructions.2: Add 3 cups of warm water gradually and blend for 5 minutes.
instructions.3: Rest the batter for 10–15 minutes.
instructions.4: Pour into a funnel or a bottle with a pierced cap.
instructions.5: Pour rounds onto a tray over medium heat until golden both sides.
instructions.6: Turn onto a clean towel and cover.
instructions.7: Prepare the fillings: cheese with parsley for savory, and nuts with dried apricots, prunes, sugar and cinnamon for sweet.
instructions.8: Fill the qatayef and seal well.
instructions.9: Fry in hot oil until golden.
instructions.10: Drain and serve with honey, syrup or thyme.

fah-508.title: Lotus Kahk
fah-508.chapter: Chapter 10: Fatma Abu Haty Channel Recipes
fah-508.culturalNotes: All-ghee or all-butter works instead of mixing. Serve plain or stamped.

instructions.1: Work the cold ghee and butter together until cohesive and creamy.
instructions.2: Add the flour, yeast, baking powder, kahk spice and salt and mix well.
instructions.3: Add the crushed Lotus biscuits and milk powder and mix into the flour.
instructions.4: Add the yeast-and-sugar mix dissolved in warm water and mix well.
instructions.5: Knead until the dough comes together.
instructions.6: Shape by stuffing a dough ball with an agameya ball and sealing well.
instructions.7: Arrange on an oiled tray and prove for 10 minutes.
instructions.8: Bake at 175°C for 20 minutes.
instructions.9: Cool completely and dust with icing sugar.

fah-509.title: Chantilly Kahk
fah-509.chapter: Chapter 10: Fatma Abu Haty Channel Recipes
fah-509.culturalNotes: Keeps in an airtight container for up to two weeks. Dust with icing sugar right before serving to keep them pretty.

instructions.1: Dissolve the yeast and sugar in half a cup of warm water and leave 10 minutes to activate.
instructions.2: In a large bowl, mix the flour, kahk spice, chantilly powder and salt.
instructions.3: Melt the ghee and add to the flour, stirring well.
instructions.4: Add the toasted sesame to the melted ghee and mix.
instructions.5: Add the yeast water gradually while stirring.
instructions.6: Knead until the dough is soft and tacky.
instructions.7: Cover with plastic and rest for 10 minutes.
instructions.8: Shape as you like — stamped, carved or plain.
instructions.9: Prove the shaped kahk for an hour until dry.
instructions.10: Bake at 180°C on the middle shelf until golden.
instructions.11: Cool completely, then dust with icing sugar just before serving.

fah-510.title: Kahk Stuffed with Agameya, Date Paste & Malban
fah-510.chapter: Chapter 10: Fatma Abu Haty Channel Recipes
fah-510.culturalNotes: Don't overfill or the kahk cracks and leaks. Pre-shape the fillings for easier stuffing.

instructions.1: Mix 3 tablespoons of ghee with 3 of flour in a bowl.
instructions.2: Toast the mix over the heat until golden.
instructions.3: Add the kahk spice and keep stirring.
instructions.4: Add the toasted sesame and a cup of toasted nuts.
instructions.5: Add the scant cup of white honey and keep stirring until it boils.
instructions.6: Leave on the heat for two minutes only.
instructions.7: Take the agameya off and cool on a plate.
instructions.8: For the date-paste filling, soften half a kilo of date paste with 2 tablespoons of butter.
instructions.9: For the malban filling, knead half a kilo of malban with 2 tablespoons of butter.
instructions.10: Add nuts or toasted peanuts to the malban to taste.
instructions.11: Shape the fillings before stuffing.
instructions.12: Chill them first so they firm up.

fah-511.title: Kunafa with Pineapple & Caramel Sauce
fah-511.chapter: Chapter 10: Fatma Abu Haty Channel Recipes
fah-511.culturalNotes: Serve cold after an hour in the fridge, cut into small pieces.

instructions.1: Make the crème pâtissière:
instructions.2: Heat the milk in a pot.
instructions.3: Separately, mix the yolks with the sugar and liquid vanilla.
instructions.4: Add the cornflour and mix well.
instructions.5: Add the egg mix gradually to the hot milk, stirring constantly.
instructions.6: Back on the heat, stir until thick.
instructions.7: Add the butter and stir until melted.
instructions.8: Turn into a bowl, cover with plastic and cool.
instructions.9: Prepare the kunafa:
instructions.10: Mix the syrup into the toasted kunafa.
instructions.11: Lay a kunafa layer in the serving tray.
instructions.12: Add a layer of the pastry cream mixed with whipped cream.
instructions.13: Top with pineapple pieces.
instructions.14: Drizzle caramel sauce on top.
instructions.15: Decorate with nuts.

fah-512.title: Kunafa with Cream
fah-512.chapter: Chapter 10: Fatma Abu Haty Channel Recipes
fah-512.culturalNotes: Keeps in the fridge for two days. Serve cold or warm.

instructions.1: Mix the milk and cornflour in a pot.
instructions.2: Heat, stirring until creamy and smooth.
instructions.3: Add the ashta and stir in.
instructions.4: Take off the heat.
instructions.5: Put the kunafa in the processor with the cup of ghee and pulse until it absorbs it.
instructions.6: Add the icing sugar and mix.
instructions.7: Spread half the kunafa in a tray evenly.
instructions.8: Add the cream mixture on top.
instructions.9: Cover with the other kunafa half.
instructions.10: Bake at 200°C for 10–15 minutes until golden.
instructions.11: Make the syrup: boil the sugar and water for 5 minutes, add the lemon juice and honey and stir.
instructions.12: Soak the kunafa with the cold syrup on all sides.
instructions.13: Decorate with crushed pistachios.
instructions.14: Cool slightly before serving.

fah-513.title: Kunafa with Crème Brûlée
fah-513.chapter: Chapter 10: Fatma Abu Haty Channel Recipes
fah-513.culturalNotes: Keeps in the fridge for up to 24 hours. Serve cold or warm.

instructions.1: Prepare the crème brûlée:
instructions.2: Beat the yolks with half a cup of sugar, the vanilla and salt in a bowl.
instructions.3: Add the 2 cups of dessert cream and mix well.
instructions.4: Warm the mixture in a pot over low heat until it starts boiling.
instructions.5: Take off and add it spoon by spoon to the beaten yolks, stirring constantly.
instructions.6: Return to the pot and stir until well heated.
instructions.7: Pour into a 24 cm Pyrex dish and bake in a water bath at 180°C for 40 minutes.
instructions.8: Prepare the kunafa:
instructions.9: Grind the kunafa in a processor.
instructions.10: Toast in a pan with 2 spoons of ghee until golden.
instructions.11: Add the honey or thick syrup to the hot kunafa and stir well.
instructions.12: Assemble and serve:
instructions.13: Spread the toasted kunafa over the crème brûlée.
instructions.14: Decorate with Lotus biscuits and Lotus butter.
instructions.15: Chill before serving.

fah-514.title: Kunafa with Chocolate Mousse
fah-514.chapter: Chapter 10: Fatma Abu Haty Channel Recipes
fah-514.culturalNotes: Serve in small cups or one large tray. Add walnuts or almonds to taste.

instructions.1: Heat the milk in a pot.
instructions.2: Add the sweetened cocoa and stir.
instructions.3: Add the milk powder and stir.
instructions.4: Add the broken plain chocolates and stir until melted.
instructions.5: Add the chantilly and cream caramel and stir well.
instructions.6: Add the cornflour dissolved in half a cup of milk and stir fast until combined.
instructions.7: Cool slightly.
instructions.8: Lay a toasted-kunafa layer in a tray.
instructions.9: Add a strawberry layer.
instructions.10: Add a chocolate-mousse layer.
instructions.11: Repeat until everything's used.
instructions.12: Finish with a kunafa layer.
instructions.13: Finish with a mousse layer.
instructions.14: Decorate with nuts.
instructions.15: Chill for at least an hour before serving.

fah-515.title: Kunafa Cheesecake with Lotus Cream
fah-515.chapter: Chapter 10: Fatma Abu Haty Channel Recipes
fah-515.culturalNotes: Extra toasted kunafa makes a nice garnish. Cool completely before chilling so the layers meld.

instructions.1: Heat the oven to 180°C.
instructions.2: Rub the ghee into the kunafa well.
instructions.3: Add the icing sugar and mix.
instructions.4: Press the kunafa firmly into a tin.
instructions.5: Bake until golden.
instructions.6: Beat the cream cheese with the chantilly, dessert cream and icing sugar until creamy.
instructions.7: Add the Lotus cream and mix well.
instructions.8: Take the kunafa out and soak with syrup.
instructions.9: Spread the cream over it evenly.
instructions.10: Microwave the Lotus cream for 10 seconds and spread over.
instructions.11: Decorate with walnuts and biscuits.
instructions.12: Cool, then refrigerate 2–3 hours before serving.

fah-516.title: Fruit-Jelly Kunafa
fah-516.chapter: Chapter 10: Fatma Abu Haty Channel Recipes
fah-516.culturalNotes: Everything must be completely cold before assembling. Serve in small cups for elegance.

fah-516-i8.name: Mixed fruit (kiwi, strawberry, grapes, banana, apple)

instructions.1: Heat the oven and get a tray.
instructions.2: Melt the ghee, add the kunafa and stir until coated.
instructions.3: Spread on the tray and bake until browned.
instructions.4: Take out, add half a cup of syrup and mix.
instructions.5: Return to the oven a few minutes, then cool.
instructions.6: Whip the chantilly with the cold milk for 5–7 minutes until thick.
instructions.7: Pipe the cream over the kunafa.
instructions.8: Chill fully.
instructions.9: Make the mango jelly: dissolve the 2 packs in 2 cups of hot water, add 2 cups of cold water and stir.
instructions.10: Pour the jelly over the kunafa and cream.
instructions.11: Refrigerate 4–5 hours until fully cold.
instructions.12: Serve cut into small pieces.

fah-517.title: Kunafa Stuffed with Dates & Walnuts
fah-517.chapter: Chapter 10: Fatma Abu Haty Channel Recipes
fah-517.culturalNotes: Grind the dates in the processor for a smoother texture. Add more syrup to taste.

instructions.1: Mix two-thirds of a cup of ghee into the kunafa well.
instructions.2: Add the quarter cup of icing sugar and mix.
instructions.3: Put a little ghee in the base of the tray and press in half the kunafa.
instructions.4: Press hard so it holds together.
instructions.5: Make the filling by mixing the dates, walnuts, cinnamon and 2 tablespoons of ghee.
instructions.6: Spread the filling and cover with the rest of the kunafa.
instructions.7: Drizzle the remaining ghee on top.
instructions.8: Bake at 200°C for 20 minutes until golden.
instructions.9: Soak with cold medium-thick syrup on both sides.
instructions.10: Serve hot or cold.

fah-518.title: Kunafa Stuffed with Cream, Strawberries & Chocolate
fah-518.chapter: Chapter 10: Fatma Abu Haty Channel Recipes
fah-518.culturalNotes: Keeps in the fridge for two days. Serve cold or warm.

instructions.1: Cut and crumble the kunafa.
instructions.2: Pour the cup of hot ghee over it and mix well.
instructions.3: Spread on the oven tray and bake at the highest heat until browned and crisp.
instructions.4: Stir occasionally for even colour.
instructions.5: Mix the white honey into the browned kunafa.
instructions.6: Heat a kilo of milk with the 2 cream-caramel sachets, the chantilly sachet and the quarter cup of sugar.
instructions.7: Add the cream or 2 tablespoons of ashta and mix.
instructions.8: Dissolve the cornflour in a quarter cup of water and add to the pot, stirring until it binds.
instructions.9: Layer the crisp kunafa in a tray and spread the cream on it.
instructions.10: Let it settle and form a crust, then decorate with toasted kunafa and nuts.
instructions.11: For the second tray, mix the quarter cup of raw cocoa and the chocolate pieces into the cream.
instructions.12: Layer kunafa in another tray and spread strawberries and the chocolate sauce.
instructions.13: Decorate with toasted kunafa and strawberries.

fah-519.title: Nabulsi Kunafa
fah-519.chapter: Chapter 10: Fatma Abu Haty Channel Recipes
fah-519.culturalNotes: The syrup should be cold and medium-thick when soaking. Serve hot or cold.

instructions.1: Desalt the cheese by soaking in water at least 3 hours, changing the water every two hours.
instructions.2: Cut and grate the cheese.
instructions.3: Freeze the kunafa a day or two so it crumbles easily.
instructions.4: Add the ghee and stir until the kunafa absorbs it all.
instructions.5: Add the icing sugar and saffron powder and mix well.
instructions.6: Press a kunafa layer into the tray.
instructions.7: Build up an edge so the cheese doesn't leak.
instructions.8: Add the akkawi and mozzarella over the kunafa.
instructions.9: Cover the cheese with another kunafa layer.
instructions.10: Drizzle the remaining ghee.
instructions.11: Cook on the stove both sides until golden.
instructions.12: Finish in the oven for colour at the edges.
instructions.13: Flash under the grill for colour on top.
instructions.14: Make the syrup by boiling a cup of sugar with a cup of water for 5 minutes.
instructions.15: Soak with the cold medium-thick syrup on both sides.

fah-520.title: Nabulsi Kunafa with Mozzarella
fah-520.chapter: Chapter 10: Fatma Abu Haty Channel Recipes
fah-520.culturalNotes: The oven must be very hot before the kunafa goes in. Serve hot for the best taste.

instructions.1: Freeze the kunafa overnight to dry it.
instructions.2: Take out and crumble gently.
instructions.3: Taste the mozzarella to make sure it isn't salty.
instructions.4: Melt the ghee over low heat.
instructions.5: Work the ghee through the kunafa to coat it.
instructions.6: Grease a basbousa tray with 2 spoons of ghee.
instructions.7: Press a quarter kilo of kunafa firmly into the tray.
instructions.8: Add the mozzarella over the kunafa.
instructions.9: Cover with another kunafa layer and press well.
instructions.10: Bake at 200°C for 20 minutes until golden.
instructions.11: Take out and soak with the cold medium-thick syrup.
instructions.12: Decorate with crushed pistachios and caramel.
instructions.13: Serve hot with vanilla ice cream.

fah-521.title: Charcoal-Fired Nabulsi Kunafa
fah-521.chapter: Chapter 10: Fatma Abu Haty Channel Recipes
fah-521.culturalNotes: Serve with coffee or tea. Keeps in the fridge for two days.

instructions.1: Cut the kunafa into small pieces.
instructions.2: Add the ghee and distribute it well.
instructions.3: Add the icing sugar and mix.
instructions.4: Put two or three spoons of ghee in the base of the tray.
instructions.5: Press a kunafa layer firmly into the tray.
instructions.6: Add the mozzarella and akkawi (soaked 8 hours in water to desalt).
instructions.7: Cover with another kunafa layer and press well.
instructions.8: Set the tray over hot coals until browned on the first side.
instructions.9: Flip and brown the other side.
instructions.10: Make the syrup: boil the sugar, water and lemon juice for 7 minutes.
instructions.11: Soak the kunafa with the hot syrup straight off the coals.
instructions.12: Rest briefly before serving.

fah-522.title: Filo Cake
fah-522.chapter: Chapter 10: Fatma Abu Haty Channel Recipes
fah-522.culturalNotes: Any filo works — even broken or stale. Ghee or oil can replace the melted butter.

instructions.1: Make the syrup: simmer the sugar, water and juice of half a lemon over medium heat for 5 minutes.
instructions.2: Make the batter: blend the melted butter, milk, sugar, eggs, vanilla, chantilly and baking powder.
instructions.3: Wrap the outside of a cheesecake tin in foil to stop leaks.
instructions.4: Grease the tin, then line the filo sheets inside, pleating and crinkling for a nice shape.
instructions.5: Pour the batter over the filo.
instructions.6: Bake the cake:
instructions.7: Bake at 170°C for 30 minutes until golden.
instructions.8: Soak with the cold syrup straight out of the oven.
instructions.9: Cool completely so it absorbs the syrup.
instructions.10: Open the tin, cut into pieces and serve.

fah-523.title: Mango Milk Cake (El-Mesrasha)
fah-523.chapter: Chapter 10: Fatma Abu Haty Channel Recipes
fah-523.culturalNotes: Regular whipping cream can replace the chantilly. Keeps in the fridge for up to 3 days.

instructions.1: Beat the eggs with the sugar and vanilla until foamy.
instructions.2: Add the oil and mix well.
instructions.3: Sift the flour, salt and baking powder separately, then add gradually while mixing.
instructions.4: Pour into a ghee-greased, floured tray.
instructions.5: Bake at 170°C for 45 minutes.
instructions.6: Prick the baked cake with a spoon or knife so it absorbs the milk.
instructions.7: Mix the milk and cream and soak the cake.
instructions.8: Whip the chantilly with the cold milk, pipe over the cake.
instructions.9: Scatter the mango cubes over the cream.
instructions.10: Add a glaze-jelly layer if you like.
instructions.11: Refrigerate at least two hours before serving.

fah-524.title: Rowani Cake
fah-524.chapter: Chapter 10: Fatma Abu Haty Channel Recipes
fah-524.culturalNotes: Serve with coffee or tea. Keeps in the fridge for up to 3 days.

instructions.1: Grease a 26 cm tin with ghee and dust with flour.
instructions.2: Heat the oven to 170°C.
instructions.3: Mix the flour, semolina, coconut, milk powder and baking powder in a bowl.
instructions.4: Blend the sugar, laban, vanilla, salt and oil.
instructions.5: Add the liquids to the dry mix and stir until combined.
instructions.6: Pour into the prepared tin.
instructions.7: Bake for 40–50 minutes.
instructions.8: Test after 40 minutes.
instructions.9: Make the syrup by boiling 2 cups of sugar with 2 cups of water for 4 minutes.
instructions.10: Take off and cool.
instructions.11: Prick the baked cake with a skewer.
instructions.12: Soak with half the syrup, flip and soak the rest.
instructions.13: Cool completely before serving.

fah-525.title: Semolina Cake (Rowani)
fah-525.chapter: Chapter 10: Fatma Abu Haty Channel Recipes
fah-525.culturalNotes: The syrup must be completely cold when soaking so it absorbs better. Decorate with nuts or coconut.

instructions.1: Make the syrup: dissolve the sugar in the water over the heat.
instructions.2: Boil, then count 4 minutes from boiling point.
instructions.3: Add the lemon juice, boil once, take off and cool completely.
instructions.4: Make the batter: beat the eggs with the vanilla, a tablespoon of vinegar and a little salt for 2 minutes until creamy.
instructions.5: Add half a cup of sugar and beat for a minute.
instructions.6: Add the yogurt and mix well.
instructions.7: Add the flour, coconut and baking powder gradually while stirring.
instructions.8: Butter and flour the tin, pour in the batter and level.
instructions.9: Bake at 170°C for 30–40 minutes.
instructions.10: Test with a wooden skewer.
instructions.11: Soak the hot cake with the cold syrup.
instructions.12: Cool slightly, then turn onto the serving dish.
instructions.13: Decorate with coconut and nuts.

fah-526.title: Mango Cake
fah-526.chapter: Chapter 10: Fatma Abu Haty Channel Recipes
fah-526.culturalNotes: Any favourite cake works — vanilla or ready-made. Keeps in the fridge for up to 3 days.

instructions.1: Make the cream: beat the cream cheese until smooth.
instructions.2: Add the chantilly, ashta, a teaspoon of vanilla, the condensed milk and half a cup of milk and whip at least 7 minutes until creamy.
instructions.3: Make the mango sauce: blend 1½ kilos of mango with 2 tablespoons of honey and half a cup of water. Keep some mango cubes for the top.
instructions.4: Split the cake in half.
instructions.5: Assemble: a cake layer, mango sauce, then cream in the serving tray.
instructions.6: Repeat until everything's used.
instructions.7: Top with the mango cubes.
instructions.8: Cover and refrigerate at least 6 hours to meld.
instructions.9: Serve cold.

fah-527.title: Orange Cake with Caramelised Orange
fah-527.chapter: Chapter 10: Fatma Abu Haty Channel Recipes
fah-527.culturalNotes: Serve with any favourite drink. Keeps in an airtight container for up to 3 days.

instructions.1: Slice the baladi oranges thinly.
instructions.2: Simmer half a cup of sugar with a quarter cup of water until boiling.
instructions.3: Add the orange slices and leave to caramelise.
instructions.4: Blend a cup of sugar, 4 eggs, a tablespoon of orange zest, half a cup of yogurt, half a cup of orange juice, a little salt and a teaspoon of vanilla.
instructions.5: Add the cup of butter-oil mix and blend until the sugar dissolves.
instructions.6: Mix 2½ cups of flour with the baking-powder sachet.
instructions.7: Add the blended mix to the flour and stir until lump-free.
instructions.8: Oil a 24 cm tin and line with baking paper.
instructions.9: Lay the caramelised orange slices in the base.
instructions.10: Pour the batter over them.
instructions.11: Bake at 170°C.
instructions.12: Bake for 40–50 minutes until done.
instructions.13: Cool slightly before serving.

fah-528.title: Seven-Cup Cake
fah-528.chapter: Chapter 10: Fatma Abu Haty Channel Recipes
fah-528.culturalNotes: Use an electric or hand whisk. Preheat the oven first. Keeps in the fridge for up to 3 days.

instructions.1: Mix the milk powder, sugar, white flour, semolina, coconut, baking powder and salt in a large bowl.
instructions.2: Add the eggs, vanilla and salt and mix well.
instructions.3: Add the vinegar and oil and mix well.
instructions.4: Add the liquid milk and stir until smooth.
instructions.5: Pour into a ghee-greased, floured tin.
instructions.6: Bake at 170°C.
instructions.7: Bake for 40–45 minutes until cooked.
instructions.8: Take out and cool slightly.
instructions.9: Make the syrup by boiling the sugar and water for 5 minutes; cool completely.
instructions.10: Soak the cake with the cold syrup, scoring it with a knife to help it penetrate.
instructions.11: Rest for 10 minutes before serving.

fah-529.title: Fluffy Mandarin Cake
fah-529.chapter: Chapter 10: Fatma Abu Haty Channel Recipes
fah-529.culturalNotes: Keeps in an airtight container for up to 3 days. Serve with coffee or tea.

instructions.1: Wash and peel the mandarins, slice thinly and blend for a concentrated juice.
instructions.2: Beat the eggs with the sugar and vanilla until the colour lightens and it goes creamy.
instructions.3: Add the oil gradually while beating, then the mandarin juice and beat again.
instructions.4: Sift the flour with the baking powder and salt, add to the mix and stir until combined.
instructions.5: Add the vinegar and fold gently one way until smooth.
instructions.6: Butter and flour the tray and pour in the batter.
instructions.7: Bake at 180°C for 50 minutes.
instructions.8: Test with a wooden skewer — clean means done.
instructions.9: Cool slightly and serve dusted with sugar.

fah-530.title: Qodra Qader Cake with Cream Caramel
fah-530.chapter: Chapter 10: Fatma Abu Haty Channel Recipes
fah-530.culturalNotes: Keeps in the fridge for up to 3 days. Serve with tea or coffee.

instructions.1: Make the caramel: melt the half cup of sugar with a quarter cup of water in an aluminium pan, swirling until dark golden. Pour into the tin.
instructions.2: Make the cream: blend the half kilo of milk, 4 eggs, 3 spoons of milk powder, half a cup of sugar and a teaspoon of vanilla until smooth. Pour over the caramel.
instructions.3: Make the cake: beat 2 eggs with a teaspoon of vanilla and a quarter cup of sugar until creamy. Add the half cup of oil and half a cup of milk and mix. Add the cocoa, baking powder, salt and sifted flour and stir until combined. Pour over the cream.
instructions.4: Bake: set the tin in a larger tray of boiling water with a quarter cup of vinegar. Bake at 180°C for an hour.
instructions.5: Serve: cool, then turn gently onto the serving plate. Serve with the caramel sauce.

fah-531.title: Coconut Jam Squares
fah-531.chapter: Chapter 10: Fatma Abu Haty Channel Recipes
fah-531.culturalNotes: Use fresh coconut — white, sweet-smelling and fresh-tasting. Keeps in an airtight container in the fridge for up to two weeks.

instructions.1: Put 600 g of sugar and half a cup of water in a pot over the heat.
instructions.2: Boil over medium heat.
instructions.3: Add 200 g of glucose syrup and stir the ingredients well.
instructions.4: Once boiling, take off the heat.
instructions.5: Add 350 g of coconut and stir well.
instructions.6: Pour into a plastic-lined, oiled tray.
instructions.7: Level the mixture.
instructions.8: Scatter 100 g of raisins on top.
instructions.9: Cover with plastic and leave 6 hours or overnight to set.
instructions.10: Cut into squares or rectangles with an oiled knife.

fah-532.title: Crispy Filo Ma'ali
fah-532.chapter: Chapter 10: Fatma Abu Haty Channel Recipes
fah-532.culturalNotes: Keeps in the fridge for up to 3 days. Serve hot or cold.

instructions.1: Break the filo and spread it in the tray.
instructions.2: Add the ghee and toss the filo in it.
instructions.3: Crumple and arrange the filo in the tray.
instructions.4: Bake at 180°C for 15 minutes until browned.
instructions.5: Mix the milk with the sugar and vanilla until the sugar dissolves.
instructions.6: Add the ashta to the milk mix and stir.
instructions.7: Pour over the toasted filo.
instructions.8: Return to the oven for 5 minutes.
instructions.9: Serve with raisins, coconut and nuts.
instructions.10: Or with vanilla ice cream.

fah-533.title: Traditional Ma'ali
fah-533.chapter: Chapter 10: Fatma Abu Haty Channel Recipes
fah-533.culturalNotes: Best eaten hot. Keeps in the fridge for up to 3 days.

instructions.1: Put a litre of milk on the heat.
instructions.2: Add half a cup of sugar and the vanilla and stir well.
instructions.3: Leave until boiling.
instructions.4: Pour into the dish when it boils.
instructions.5: Spread the ma'ali in the dish and mix in.
instructions.6: Add raisins and cinnamon to taste.
instructions.7: Add a spoon of ashta for extra richness.
instructions.8: Bake at 180°C for 20 minutes.
instructions.9: Take out and cool slightly.

fah-534.title: Malban Rope & Doll Candy
fah-534.chapter: Chapter 10: Fatma Abu Haty Channel Recipes
fah-534.culturalNotes: Keep stirring so the malban doesn't catch on the bottom. Orange-blossom water can replace the vanilla.

instructions.1: Mix half the water with the sugar in a pot.
instructions.2: Add the glucose syrup and stir until dissolved.
instructions.3: Separately, mix the cornflour with the rest of the water until smooth.
instructions.4: Add the cornflour mix gradually to the sugar over the heat, stirring constantly.
instructions.5: Keep stirring over medium heat until thick and translucent (about an hour and a half).
instructions.6: Add the citric acid and vanilla and stir.
instructions.7: Dip a stick in the hot malban and hang it to dry (about 6 hours or overnight).
instructions.8: Oil a tray, pour half the malban and scatter nuts on top.
instructions.9: Colour the rest red and mix well.
instructions.10: Pour over and level with an oiled spatula.
instructions.11: Cool and dry (about 6 hours or overnight).
instructions.12: Cut into shapes and serve.

fah-535.title: Mini Kahk
fah-535.chapter: Chapter 10: Fatma Abu Haty Channel Recipes
fah-535.culturalNotes: Store in a sealed metal tin to keep them crisp. Milk powder can replace the water, but water gives a better result.

instructions.1: Beat the cold ghee with the sifted icing sugar until creamy.
instructions.2: Sift in the kahk flour, baking powder, kahk spice and salt.
instructions.3: Add the chantilly powder and mix.
instructions.4: Add the warm water gradually, kneading until smooth.
instructions.5: Shape small pieces and stamp them as you like.
instructions.6: Rest on a tray for half an hour before baking.
instructions.7: Heat the oven — 160°C for plain, 180°C for stuffed.
instructions.8: Bake for 30 minutes or until golden.
instructions.9: Cool completely before dusting with icing sugar.

fah-666.title: Syrian Barazeq
fah-666.chapter: Chapter 10: Fatma Abu Haty Channel Recipes
fah-666.culturalNotes: Cover the dough well with sesame and pistachios for a nice look. Peanuts work if pistachios aren't available. Lift the barazeq off the tray while hot so they don't stick.

instructions.1: Mix the butter with the icing sugar and vanilla in a bowl.
instructions.2: Add the egg and oil and mix well.
instructions.3: Add the sifted flour, baking powder, milk powder and salt and mix until a dough forms.
instructions.4: If the dough is dry, add water as needed.
instructions.5: Cover and refrigerate for half an hour.
instructions.6: Heat the oven to 170°C.
instructions.7: Oil a tray.
instructions.8: Toast the sesame in the oven until light golden.
instructions.9: Mix the thick syrup into the sesame.
instructions.10: Crack the pistachios into small pieces.
instructions.11: Take a piece of dough, ball it, and dip it in the pistachios.
instructions.12: Top with a spoon of the sesame-syrup mix.
instructions.13: Set the barazeq on the oiled tray.
instructions.14: Bake for 10 minutes until golden.
instructions.15: Lift the barazeq off the tray while still hot.

fah-667.title: Old-Style Muhaggah
fah-667.chapter: Chapter 10: Fatma Abu Haty Channel Recipes
fah-667.culturalNotes: Tahweegah is a spice blend — mughat, fennel, anise — from the spice merchant. The muhaggah turns crisp when you cut it straight out of the oven.

instructions.1: Mix the flour, baking powder and salt in a large bowl.
instructions.2: Add the tahweegah and coconut and stir well.
instructions.3: Add the sifted icing sugar and stir again.
instructions.4: Warm the oil and ghee in a pan over medium heat.
instructions.5: Add the sesame and nigella and toast until golden.
instructions.6: Take off the heat and tip the pan's contents into the flour, mixing well.
instructions.7: Keep stirring until it cools slightly.
instructions.8: Add the molasses and mix until combined.
instructions.9: Spread in a 30×40 oiled square tray.
instructions.10: Level by hand or with a rolling pin.
instructions.11: Score into squares before baking.
instructions.12: Heat the oven to 170°C.
instructions.13: Bake on the middle shelf for 30–40 minutes.
instructions.14: Take out and cool slightly.
instructions.15: Recut along the same lines.
instructions.16: Serve with a warm cup of tea.

fah-668.title: Papa Roti Coffee Buns
fah-668.chapter: Chapter 10: Fatma Abu Haty Channel Recipes
fah-668.culturalNotes: The butter must be frozen when it goes into the buns so it doesn't melt out. Keeps in a sealed container in the fridge for up to 3 days.

instructions.1: Mix the flour, milk powder, sugar, yeast, salt and baking powder in a bowl.
instructions.2: Add the egg, butter and vanilla and mix well.
instructions.3: Add the warm milk gradually until the dough comes together.
instructions.4: Knead for 10 minutes until smooth and elastic.
instructions.5: Put in an oiled bowl, cover with plastic and a clean towel, and prove for an hour.
instructions.6: Cut into lemon-sized balls (about 40 g each).
instructions.7: Cover and rest for 15 minutes.
instructions.8: Flatten each ball, put a cube of frozen butter in the centre, and ball it up again.
instructions.9: Space them on an oiled tray or baking paper.
instructions.10: Make the topping: mix the butter, sugar, vanilla, Nescafé, hot water and sifted flour.
instructions.11: Pipe the topping over the buns.
instructions.12: Bake at 200°C for 10–12 minutes until golden.
instructions.13: Serve hot with chocolate or caramel sauce.

fah-669.title: Cheese Pancakes
fah-669.chapter: Chapter 10: Fatma Abu Haty Channel Recipes
fah-669.culturalNotes: Add basturma if you like. Serve hot with honey or icing sugar.

instructions.1: Beat the egg and milk together in a bowl.
instructions.2: Add the black pepper, salt, sugar, flour and baking powder and mix well.
instructions.3: Add the areesh cheese and coloured peppers and mix well.
instructions.4: Add the oats if you like.
instructions.5: Heat a pan over medium heat and oil it.
instructions.6: Ladle the batter in by the tablespoon per pancake.
instructions.7: Flip when the underside is golden.
instructions.8: Repeat until the batter is done.

fah-670.title: Sweet & Savory Pancakes
fah-670.chapter: Chapter 10: Fatma Abu Haty Channel Recipes
fah-670.culturalNotes: Any fruit you have works for the sweet ones, and any cheese for the savory.

instructions.1: Mix the whole-grain flour, vinegar, salt, sugar and milk in a large bowl.
instructions.2: Stir until smooth and lump-free.
instructions.3: Add the baking powder and melted butter and mix well.
instructions.4: Pour the batter into a squeeze bottle or a bottle with a pierced cap.
instructions.5: Oil the pan lightly and wipe with a tissue.
instructions.6: Heat the pan and pour the batter in circles.
instructions.7: After ten seconds, drop a spoon of water on each pancake and cover the pan.
instructions.8: Leave until golden and fluffy.
instructions.9: For savory ones: a little batter, a piece of Roumy cheese, then more batter on top.
instructions.10: After ten seconds, add a spoon of water and flip the pan.
