instructions.11: Repeat until the batter is done.
instructions.12: Serve the sweet pancakes with fruit and honey, the savory with cheese.

fah-671.title: Cheese Biscuits
fah-671.chapter: Chapter 10: Fatma Abu Haty Channel Recipes
fah-671.culturalNotes: Great as a school snack for kids — add fruit or vegetables for extra nutrition.

instructions.1: Rub the flour and butter together until like damp sand.
instructions.2: Add the grated Roumy, salt and baking powder and mix the dry ingredients well.
instructions.3: Add the egg and half a cup of milk and knead into a cohesive dough.
instructions.4: Cover and refrigerate for 30 minutes.
instructions.5: Roll out to about half a centimetre.
instructions.6: Cut shapes with cutters.
instructions.7: Arrange on a lightly oiled tray.
instructions.8: Mix the yolk with a spoon of milk and a pinch of sugar and brush the tops.
instructions.9: Sprinkle grated cheese on top.
instructions.10: Bake at 160°C for 15 minutes until golden.
instructions.11: Take out and cool.
instructions.12: Serve or store in a sealed box or the freezer.

fah-672.title: Chocolate Swirl Biscuits
fah-672.chapter: Chapter 10: Fatma Abu Haty Channel Recipes
fah-672.culturalNotes: Store in a sealed tin to keep them tender and crisp longer.

instructions.1: Beat the icing sugar with the butter and vanilla until pale and creamy.
instructions.2: Add the egg and beat for 2–3 minutes.
instructions.3: Add the sifted flour and salt and mix by hand until a dough forms.
instructions.4: Split the dough in half. Work the sweetened and raw cocoa into one half.
instructions.5: Roll small balls and scatter them alternately on an oiled tray or baking paper.
instructions.6: Bake at 160°C for 15 minutes until golden.
instructions.7: Cool before serving.

fah-673.title: Linzer-Style Biscuits
fah-673.chapter: Chapter 10: Fatma Abu Haty Channel Recipes
fah-673.culturalNotes: Any jam you like — strawberry or apricot. Decorate with melted chocolate or ground nuts too.

instructions.1: Beat the sugar and ghee with a hand or electric whisk.
instructions.2: Add the eggs and vanilla and mix.
instructions.3: Mix the flour, cornflour, baking powder and salt separately.
instructions.4: Sift the flour mix into the sugar mix and combine.
instructions.5: Cover and refrigerate for 30 minutes.
instructions.6: Heat the oven to 160°C.
instructions.7: Shape small balls and set on baking paper.
instructions.8: Bake for 15 minutes until golden.
instructions.9: Take out and cool.
instructions.10: Decorate with ground hazelnuts, sprinkles, jam, pistachios or chocolate.

fah-674.title: Banana Biscuits
fah-674.chapter: Chapter 10: Fatma Abu Haty Channel Recipes
fah-674.culturalNotes: Serve with tea or milk — good for breakfast or dinner. Keeps in an airtight container for up to a week.

instructions.1: Work the date paste with cold butter until soft, and shape thin fingers.
instructions.2: Mix the sifted flour, baking powder, salt and icing sugar in a bowl.
instructions.3: Add the ghee and mix until the flour absorbs it.
instructions.4: Add the egg and vanilla and mix well.
instructions.5: Add water gradually until the dough is soft and easy to shape.
instructions.6: Shape small balls the size of lemons.
instructions.7: Roll each ball very thin on a floured surface.
instructions.8: Put a date finger in the centre and roll up.
instructions.9: Curve into a banana shape and arrange on an oiled tray.
instructions.10: Brush with beaten egg mixed with a teaspoon of vanilla.
instructions.11: Bake at 170°C for 15 minutes until golden.

fah-675.title: Anise Biscuits
fah-675.chapter: Chapter 10: Fatma Abu Haty Channel Recipes
fah-675.culturalNotes: Serve with tea or coffee. Keeps in an airtight container for up to a week.

instructions.1: Mix the eggs with the vanilla, vinegar and salt in a bowl.
instructions.2: Add the butter, oil and sugar and mix well.
instructions.3: Add the flour and baking powder and mix until a dough forms.
instructions.4: Split the dough in half. Work the anise into one half.
instructions.5: Work the cinnamon and walnuts (if using) into the other half.
instructions.6: Grease a small tray with ghee and dust with flour.
instructions.7: Spread the dough and bake at 170°C for 15 minutes.
instructions.8: Take out and cool.
instructions.9: Cut into thin slices and arrange on an aluminium tray.
instructions.10: Bake again at 150°C for 15 minutes until golden.
instructions.11: Cool completely before serving.

fah-676.title: Savory Brown-Flour Biscuits
fah-676.chapter: Chapter 10: Fatma Abu Haty Channel Recipes
fah-676.culturalNotes: Serve with labneh or cheese with olive oil and nigella — perfect for breakfast or a snack.

instructions.1: Mix the brown flour, sesame, nigella, thyme, sugar, baking powder and salt in a bowl.
instructions.2: Add the half cup of oil and cup of ghee or butter and mix until like damp sand.
instructions.3: Add the half cup of warm water with a teaspoon of yeast and a spoon of tomato sauce and mix into a dough.
instructions.4: Cover and prove for half an hour.
instructions.5: Roll half the dough on a plastic sheet to half a centimetre and scatter seeds on top.
instructions.6: Cut circles with a cutter or cup.
instructions.7: Lay them on an oiled tray.
instructions.8: Heat the oven at 180°C for 15 minutes.
instructions.9: Bake until golden.
instructions.10: Cool slightly before serving.

fah-677.title: Nigella-Seed Biscuits
fah-677.chapter: Chapter 10: Fatma Abu Haty Channel Recipes
fah-677.culturalNotes: Serve with tea or coffee. Keeps in an airtight container for up to a week.

instructions.1: Mix the flour, ground mahlab, baking powder, salt and sugar in a large bowl.
instructions.2: Add the butter and oil and mix until the flour absorbs the fat.
instructions.3: Add the vinegar and yogurt and mix gently until combined.
instructions.4: Take small balls of dough and shape into logs.
instructions.5: Lay the logs on an oiled tray.
instructions.6: Brush with beaten egg and sprinkle nigella seeds.
instructions.7: Heat the oven to 170°C.
instructions.8: Bake on the middle shelf for 15–20 minutes until golden.
instructions.9: Cool slightly before serving.

fah-678.title: Hadouta Biscuits
fah-678.chapter: Chapter 10: Fatma Abu Haty Channel Recipes
fah-678.culturalNotes: Keeps a long time in a sealed metal tin. Serve with cheese or tea for a light breakfast.

instructions.1: Mix the oil and ghee in a bowl.
instructions.2: Add the sugar, salt, baking powder and egg yolk and mix well.
instructions.3: Add the vinegar and keep stirring.
instructions.4: Add the flour gradually, stirring, until a dough forms.
instructions.5: Add the milk gradually until the dough is soft and easy to shape.
instructions.6: Cover and rest for 10 minutes.
instructions.7: Roll out on a cornflour-dusted surface to about half a centimetre.
instructions.8: Cut into rectangles about 2 cm wide.
instructions.9: Dip the tops in egg white, then sprinkle sesame and nigella.
instructions.10: Set on an oiled tray.
instructions.11: Bake at 160°C for 15 minutes or until golden.
instructions.12: Cool before serving.

fah-679.title: Digestive Biscuits (No Eggs or Milk)
fah-679.chapter: Chapter 10: Fatma Abu Haty Channel Recipes
fah-679.culturalNotes: Serve with dips — hummus, areesh cheese, cherry tomatoes. Keeps in an airtight container for up to a week.

instructions.1: Mix the flour, sugar, baking powder and salt in a large bowl.
instructions.2: Add the oil and butter and mix well.
instructions.3: Add water gradually until the dough is cohesive and easy to shape.
instructions.4: Cover the bowl with an oiled plastic sheet.
instructions.5: Roll a piece of dough between two plastic sheets to about half a centimetre.
instructions.6: Cut into equal circles.
instructions.7: Lay on an oiled tray and prick with a fork.
instructions.8: Bake at 170°C for 15 minutes until golden.
instructions.9: Take out and cool.

fah-680.title: Savory Sesame & Nigella Biscuits
fah-680.chapter: Chapter 10: Fatma Abu Haty Channel Recipes
fah-680.culturalNotes: Have them with cheese or your favourite dip. Keeps in an airtight container for up to a week.

instructions.1: Heat the oven to 170°C.
instructions.2: Toast the sesame and nigella in a pan until fragrant.
instructions.3: Add half a cup of melted butter, half a cup of corn oil and half a cup of milk.
instructions.4: Add a teaspoon of salt, a tablespoon of sugar, a tablespoon of fine semolina and a teaspoon of baking powder.
instructions.5: Mix well.
instructions.6: Add the 2½ cups of sifted flour and stir until combined.
instructions.7: Roll on a plastic sheet to about half a centimetre.
instructions.8: Cut small shapes with a knife.
instructions.9: Arrange on an oiled tray.
instructions.10: Bake until golden top and bottom.
instructions.11: Take out and cool.
instructions.12: Serve with tea or coffee.

fah-681.title: Yogurt Date-Filled Biscuits
fah-681.chapter: Chapter 10: Fatma Abu Haty Channel Recipes
fah-681.culturalNotes: Serve with tea or any drink. A handy school snack too.

instructions.1: Mix the yogurt with the sugar until dissolved.
instructions.2: Add the ghee-oil mix and stir well.
instructions.3: Add the salt and vanilla and stir.
instructions.4: Add the flour and baking powder and mix by hand until a dough forms.
instructions.5: Press a thin layer into a plastic-lined rectangular tray.
instructions.6: Prepare the date paste with butter and extras to taste (sesame or cardamom).
instructions.7: Spread the date paste over the first dough layer.
instructions.8: Oil the tray, add half the remaining dough and spread it.
instructions.9: Add the date layer and cover with the rest of the dough.
instructions.10: Brush the top with milk, cream or ashta and sprinkle toasted sesame.
instructions.11: Cut into squares.
instructions.12: Bake at medium heat until browned.

fah-682.title: Eggless Biscuits with 3 Dips
fah-682.chapter: Chapter 10: Fatma Abu Haty Channel Recipes
fah-682.culturalNotes: Serve with the different dips for variety. Keeps in an airtight container for up to a week.

instructions.1: Mix the flour, sugar, baking powder and salt in a bowl.
instructions.2: Add the oil and butter and mix well.
instructions.3: Add water gradually until easy to shape.
instructions.4: Cover the bowl with an oiled plastic sheet.
instructions.5: Roll a piece between two plastic sheets to about half a centimetre.
instructions.6: Cut into equal circles.
instructions.7: Lay on an oiled tray.
instructions.8: Bake at 170°C for 15 minutes until golden.
instructions.9: Prepare the dips:
instructions.10: Hummus dip: blend chickpeas, lemon juice, tahini, cumin, coriander, paprika, chopped tomato and cold water until smooth.
instructions.11: Yogurt dip: mix yogurt, areesh cheese, olive oil, salt and thyme.
instructions.12: Cheese dip: mix cubed cheese, chopped cherry tomatoes, chilli and olives.

fah-683.title: Chocolate Buns
fah-683.chapter: Chapter 10: Fatma Abu Haty Channel Recipes
fah-683.culturalNotes: The dough works sweet or savory. Dust with icing sugar for a prettier finish. The improver works in any dough for fluffiness and a sweet taste.

instructions.1: Mix the improver ingredients: yogurt, flour, baking powder and vinegar until foamy.
instructions.2: Separately, mix the flour, sugar, yeast and salt. Add the warm water and egg white and knead well.
instructions.3: Add the improver and knead for 10 minutes until stretchy and soft.
instructions.4: Oil the proving bowl, set the dough in, cover with plastic and a towel and prove until doubled.
instructions.5: Roll out, spread with soft butter, sugar and chocolate chips, then roll up and cut.
instructions.6: Brush the tops with yolk mixed with milk and vanilla. Add nuts to taste.
instructions.7: Bake at 200°C for 20 minutes until golden.

fah-684.title: Turkish Börek
fah-684.chapter: Chapter 10: Fatma Abu Haty Channel Recipes
fah-684.culturalNotes: Add other cheeses if you like. Freeze after cooking and reheat 30 seconds in the microwave. A snack or breakfast.

instructions.1: Mix the yogurt with butter until smooth and creamy.
instructions.2: Add 4–5 spoons of liquid butter and mix well.
instructions.3: Grease the tray with a butter-oil mix.
instructions.4: Brush a filo sheet with the yogurt-butter mix.
instructions.5: Spread cream cheese on it.
instructions.6: Add the cheese-and-basturma mix.
instructions.7: Roll the two sheets with the filling and lay on the tray.
instructions.8: Repeat until done.
instructions.9: Cut the börek into pieces.
instructions.10: Brush the tops with the butter-oil mix.
instructions.11: Bake at 200°C for 15 minutes until golden.

fah-685.title: Turkish Börek with Mince
fah-685.chapter: Chapter 10: Fatma Abu Haty Channel Recipes
fah-685.culturalNotes: Keep the börek in the fridge up to 24 hours before baking. Serve with tomato sauce or red sauce.

instructions.1: Grate the raw potatoes.
instructions.2: Add the black pepper, paprika and salt to the grated potato and mix well.
instructions.3: Add the minced meat and mix until combined.
instructions.4: Take a filo sheet and brush with water then with ghee-oil.
instructions.5: Repeat with 3 sheets.
instructions.6: Lay the filling lengthwise on the last sheet and roll carefully.
instructions.7: Repeat for all sheets.
instructions.8: Set the börek on an oiled tray.
instructions.9: Brush the tops with yolk mixed with milk.
instructions.10: Sprinkle sesame and nigella.
instructions.11: Bake at 180°C for 20 minutes until golden.
instructions.12: Cool slightly before serving.

fah-686.title: Potato Pizza
fah-686.chapter: Chapter 10: Fatma Abu Haty Channel Recipes
fah-686.culturalNotes: Serve with a green salad or tomato sauce.

instructions.1: Heat a pan and add a tablespoon of butter.
instructions.2: Add the boiled mashed potato and stir well.
instructions.3: Season with salt and pepper.
instructions.4: Spread in an oiled tray.
instructions.5: Top with the grated cheese.
instructions.6: Add the tomato, pepper and olive slices.
instructions.7: Bake on low for 15 minutes until the top is golden.
instructions.8: Serve hot.

fah-687.title: Mini Pizza Pies
fah-687.chapter: Chapter 10: Fatma Abu Haty Channel Recipes
fah-687.culturalNotes: Any cheese works. Keeps in the fridge for two days or freeze longer.

instructions.1: Mix the warm water with the sugar and yeast.
instructions.2: Leave 4 minutes to activate.
instructions.3: Add the flour, oil and salt and stir until a dough forms.
instructions.4: Rest for 10 minutes until doubled.
instructions.5: Cut into equal balls.
instructions.6: Oil a tray and press out the dough.
instructions.7: Add the cheese-and-pepper filling.
instructions.8: Bake in a very hot oven for 10 minutes until golden.
instructions.9: Serve hot.

fah-688.title: Tray Pizza with Cheese Sauce
fah-688.chapter: Chapter 10: Fatma Abu Haty Channel Recipes
fah-688.culturalNotes: Add any toppings you like. The dough keeps in the fridge up to 24 hours.

instructions.1: Mix the flour, sugar, salt, baking powder and yeast in a large bowl.
instructions.2: Add warm water gradually, kneading until a dough forms.
instructions.3: Add the oil and knead 3–4 minutes.
instructions.4: Cover and prove for 15 minutes.
instructions.5: Separately, melt the butter on low, add the flour and stir.
instructions.6: Add the milk gradually, stirring, until the sauce is smooth.
instructions.7: Add the mozzarella and stir until melted.
instructions.8: Take off and set aside.
instructions.9: Mix the tomato sauce, ketchup, onion powder, garlic powder and thyme.
instructions.10: Oil the oven tray and dust with semolina.
instructions.11: Spread the dough to shape.
instructions.12: Spread the pizza sauce evenly.
instructions.13: Spread the cheese sauce evenly.
instructions.14: Add cheddar, mozzarella, salami, onion, green pepper, olives and chilli to taste.
instructions.15: Bake at 220°C for 15 minutes until golden.

fah-689.title: Soft Tasty Toast Bread
fah-689.chapter: Chapter 10: Fatma Abu Haty Channel Recipes
fah-689.culturalNotes: The dough should be smooth before proving. Milk powder in the flour improves the taste. A preheated oven gives better results.

fah-689-i11.name: Warm water to test the yeast

instructions.1: Mix the yeast and sugar in the quarter cup of warm water and leave 10 minutes to test it.
instructions.2: Mix the baking powder, improver and salt with the flour.
instructions.3: Add the yeast mix, warm milk, yogurt and oil and knead.
instructions.4: Add warm water gradually as needed until cohesive.
instructions.5: Knead for 10 minutes until smooth.
instructions.6: Cover and prove in a warm place for 30 minutes or until doubled.
instructions.7: Cut into small pieces and ball them.
instructions.8: Shape and set on an oiled tray.
instructions.9: Prove again 10–15 minutes.
instructions.10: Brush with a mix of milk powder, Nescafé, water and sugar.
instructions.11: Bake at 200°C for 20–30 minutes until golden.
instructions.12: Cover with a towel out of the oven to soften for slicing.

fah-690.title: Filo Rolls with 4 Fillings
fah-690.chapter: Chapter 10: Fatma Abu Haty Channel Recipes
fah-690.culturalNotes: Filo keeps in the freezer for later. Serve hot or toast them.

instructions.1: Apple filling: cube the apples and cook with butter, cinnamon and sugar until the liquid dries off.
instructions.2: Fat mix: combine the yogurt, ghee and baking powder.
instructions.3: Potato filling: mash the boiled potatoes with cheese, parsley and cream cheese.
instructions.4: Cheese filling: mix mozzarella, pepper, Roumy and cream cheese.
instructions.5: Cheesecake filling: jam in one piping bag, cream cheese in another.
instructions.6: Lay a filo sheet, brush with the fat mix, fold in half and brush again. Put filling in the centre, fold the ends and roll.
instructions.7: Cook in a pan with a drop of ghee or oil, turning until golden all over.

fah-691.title: Danish
fah-691.chapter: Chapter 10: Fatma Abu Haty Channel Recipes
fah-691.culturalNotes: Sprinkle sesame on top for looks. Keeps in an airtight container for up to 3 days.

instructions.1: Mix the yeast with warm water and sugar and set aside to activate.
instructions.2: Separately, mix the flour, milk powder, baking powder and salt.
instructions.3: Add the yeast mix to the flour and knead well.
instructions.4: Add the oil gradually, kneading until soft and smooth.
instructions.5: Cover and prove for 30 minutes until doubled.
instructions.6: Cut into small pieces and ball them.
instructions.7: Roll each piece very thin.
instructions.8: Brush with butter and roll up.
instructions.9: Set on an oiled tray or baking paper.
instructions.10: Prove again 15 minutes.
instructions.11: Bake at 180°C for 15–20 minutes until golden.
instructions.12: Brush with honey and jam and top with cherries.

fah-692.title: Baked Oil-Free Donuts
fah-692.chapter: Chapter 10: Fatma Abu Haty Channel Recipes
fah-692.culturalNotes: Grated dark chocolate in the sauce gives a stronger taste. Shape the donuts however you like.

instructions.1: Mix the flour, yeast, sugar, baking powder and salt in a bowl.
instructions.2: Add the egg, vinegar and warm water gradually and knead for 5 minutes.
instructions.3: Add the melted butter and knead 5 more minutes.
instructions.4: Cover and prove in a warm place for an hour until doubled.
instructions.5: Mix the milk, sugar, cornflour and cocoa and stir over the heat until thick.
instructions.6: Add the butter and stir until melted, then cool the sauce.
instructions.7: Cut the dough into equal pieces on an oiled tray.
instructions.8: Cover and prove again 15 minutes.
instructions.9: Heat the oven high for 15 minutes.
instructions.10: Brush the donuts with yolk beaten with a spoon of milk.
instructions.11: Bake for 10–12 minutes until golden.
instructions.12: Cool, then inject the chocolate sauce.
instructions.13: Serve warm or cold.

fah-693.title: Samosa Crisps
fah-693.chapter: Chapter 10: Fatma Abu Haty Channel Recipes
fah-693.culturalNotes: Change the filling as you like — vegetarian or cheese. Keeps in the freezer for up to a month.

instructions.1: Mix 3 cups of flour with a teaspoon of salt and 3 teaspoons of oil.
instructions.2: Add water gradually and knead to a medium dough.
instructions.3: Cover with plastic and rest for 15 minutes.
instructions.4: Cut into 14 small balls.
instructions.5: Flour the balls and roll thin.
instructions.6: Make the filling: brown the onion in ghee, add the spiced meat, spices and parsley and stir.
instructions.7: Put filling in the centre of each piece and seal well.
instructions.8: Cut the samosas to shape.
instructions.9: Fry in medium-hot oil until golden and crisp.

fah-694.title: Cheese Rolls
fah-694.chapter: Chapter 10: Fatma Abu Haty Channel Recipes
fah-694.culturalNotes: Freeze cooled rolls in sealed bags for later.

instructions.1: Mix the sugar and yeast in the warm water and leave 10 minutes to activate.
instructions.2: Add the sifted flour, baking powder and yogurt and mix well.
instructions.3: Knead for 5 minutes, add the oil and knead 5 more until smooth.
instructions.4: Cover and prove in a warm place for 30 minutes until doubled.
instructions.5: Dice the red and green pepper and mix with the baramily and cream cheese.
instructions.6: Flour the surface and roll the dough to half a centimetre.
instructions.7: Spread the filling and cut 2 cm slices.
instructions.8: Roll the slices and set on an oiled tray.
instructions.9: Prove again for 30 minutes.
instructions.10: Brush with beaten egg and sprinkle sesame and nigella.
instructions.11: Bake in a hot oven for 15 minutes until golden.

fah-695.title: Fluffy School Sandwiches
fah-695.chapter: Chapter 10: Fatma Abu Haty Channel Recipes
fah-695.culturalNotes: Freeze for later. Serve with a cup of tea.

instructions.1: Mix the flour, milk powder, salt, yeast, sugar and baking powder in a bowl.
instructions.2: Add the yogurt, oil and warm water gradually and mix well.
instructions.3: Knead for at least 10 minutes until cohesive and smooth.
instructions.4: Cover with plastic and a clean towel and prove for an hour.
instructions.5: Cut into equal parts and ball them.
instructions.6: Cover again and rest for 15 minutes.
instructions.7: Roll each ball into a thin rectangle.
instructions.8: Lay a sausage in the centre and roll up.
instructions.9: Halve the roll into mini sandwiches.
instructions.10: Arrange on an oiled tray and prove for 10 minutes.
instructions.11: Brush with egg and sprinkle sesame.
instructions.12: Bake in a hot oven for 15 minutes until golden.

fah-696.title: Cheese-Stuffed Sandwiches
fah-696.chapter: Chapter 10: Fatma Abu Haty Channel Recipes
fah-696.culturalNotes: Add any fillings you like. Keeps in the fridge two days or freeze longer. Serve hot or cold.

instructions.1: Mix the pastry flour, yeast, sugar and salt in a bowl.
instructions.2: Add the egg white, vinegar and warm water and knead for 10 minutes until soft and cohesive.
instructions.3: Cover and prove for half an hour in a warm place.
instructions.4: Cut into 8 equal pieces and ball them.
instructions.5: Roll each ball and stuff with your favourite filling (mixed cheese, olives, basturma, baramily, peppers, feta).
instructions.6: Seal well and shape into rolls.
instructions.7: Set in bread moulds.
instructions.8: Brush with yolk-milk mix and dust with rusks.
instructions.9: Brush with the butter-thyme-garlic-sesame mix.
instructions.10: Bake in a hot oven for 20 minutes until golden and crisp.

fah-697.title: Puff Samosas
fah-697.chapter: Chapter 10: Fatma Abu Haty Channel Recipes
fah-697.culturalNotes: Unfried samosas keep in the freezer for up to a month. Thaw slightly before frying.

instructions.1: Mix the flour, cornflour, baking powder, sugar, salt and milk powder in a bowl.
instructions.2: Add the ghee or oil and mix until like sand grains.
instructions.3: Add warm water gradually and mix into a soft, non-sticky dough.
instructions.4: Cover and rest for 30 minutes to an hour.
instructions.5: Divide into 3 balls and cover.
instructions.6: Dust the surface with cornflour and roll to about half a centimetre.
instructions.7: Cut circles with a cutter.
instructions.8: Add your favourite filling and seal your way.
instructions.9: Set on an oiled or cornflour-dusted tray.
instructions.10: Deep-fry until golden on both sides.
instructions.11: Cook until golden and drain on a paper towel.

fah-698.title: Cinnabon Samosas
fah-698.chapter: Chapter 10: Fatma Abu Haty Channel Recipes
fah-698.culturalNotes: Serve with caramel or chocolate sauce. Keeps in an airtight container for up to 3 days.

instructions.1: Mix the icing sugar with the cocoa and cinnamon in a bowl.
instructions.2: Fill the samosa strips with ashta or Kiri cheese.
instructions.3: Seal them into envelope shapes.
instructions.4: Heat oil in a pan, then lower the heat.
instructions.5: Fry until golden on both sides.
instructions.6: Drain on a paper towel.
instructions.7: Coat all over in the sugar-cocoa-cinnamon mix.
instructions.8: Serve hot with caramel or chocolate sauce.

fah-699.title: Multi-Filling Samosas (Meatless)
fah-699.chapter: Chapter 10: Fatma Abu Haty Channel Recipes
fah-699.culturalNotes: Freeze for later. Serve with red or white sauces.

instructions.1: Heat oil in a pan.
instructions.2: Add the garlic and fry until light yellow.
instructions.3: Add the boiled potatoes and mash well.
instructions.4: Add the cumin, coriander, black pepper, salt, spring onion, fresh coriander, red pepper, smoked paprika and potato spices and mix well.
instructions.5: Separately, heat oil and fry the chopped onion until soft.
instructions.6: Add the curry and black pepper and stir.
instructions.7: Add the boiled peas and carrots and the instant stock and stir.
instructions.8: Add salt and stir.
instructions.9: Cheese filling: mix areesh cheese with nigella, olive oil, ashta, parsley, pepper and black olives.
instructions.10: Second filling: mix cheddar, mozzarella, Roumy, cream cheese, red baladi pepper and coloured peppers.
instructions.11: Third filling: tomato, olives, basturma, the remaining cheese, ketchup and thyme.
instructions.12: Mix flour with water for the sealing paste.
instructions.13: Roll the dough and cut circles.
instructions.14: Fill and seal neatly.
instructions.15: Brush the edges with the paste so they don't open while frying.
instructions.16: Fry in hot oil until golden.

fah-700.title: Crispy Anise Shaboura
fah-700.chapter: Chapter 10: Fatma Abu Haty Channel Recipes
fah-700.culturalNotes: Serve with a hot cup of tea. Nigella and anise are healthy ingredients.

instructions.1: Put the eggs in the blender.
instructions.2: Add the oil, sugar, vinegar, half a cup of milk, the vanilla and saffron.
instructions.3: Blend until the sugar dissolves.
instructions.4: Add the salt, nigella and baking powder and blend.
instructions.5: Add the flour gradually until a dough forms.
instructions.6: Grease a rectangular tin and spread the dough.
instructions.7: Sprinkle sesame and nigella on top.
instructions.8: Bake at 180°C.
instructions.9: Bake for 40–45 minutes until cooked.
instructions.10: Take out and cool slightly.
instructions.11: Slice and toast again at 140°C until crisp.

fah-701.title: Cream Filo Fingers
fah-701.chapter: Chapter 10: Fatma Abu Haty Channel Recipes
fah-701.culturalNotes: Serve hot or cold. Any nuts work. Keeps in an airtight container for up to 3 days.

instructions.1: Unroll the filo and cut into 10×10 cm squares.
instructions.2: Make the cream: a tin of ready ashta, or a cup of milk thickened with a spoon of cornflour on the heat.
instructions.3: Take two squares and lay cream along the diagonal, away from the edges.
instructions.4: Fold into fingers and set on a buttered tray.
instructions.5: A light drizzle of melted butter on each.
instructions.6: Bake at 200°C for 10 minutes until golden.
instructions.7: Drizzle white honey over them straight out of the oven.

fah-702.title: Brioche Braids
fah-702.chapter: Chapter 10: Fatma Abu Haty Channel Recipes
fah-702.culturalNotes: Use good yeast and knead well for a fluffy result. Serve with coloured boiled eggs at Sham el-Nessim.

instructions.1: Mix the yeast and sugar in the warm milk.
instructions.2: Mix the salt into the flour.
instructions.3: Add the yeast-milk mix to the flour and knead well.
instructions.4: Add the butter and knead until smooth.
instructions.5: Cover and prove in a warm place for an hour.
instructions.6: Cut into small balls and roll each into a long strip.
instructions.7: Braid three strips and arrange on an oiled or lined tray.
instructions.8: Prove again for 30 minutes.
instructions.9: Brush with the yolk-milk-Nescafé mix.
instructions.10: Bake at 200°C for 20 minutes until golden.
instructions.11: Serve hot with tea or coffee.

fah-703.title: Sandwich Dough (3 Fillings)
fah-703.chapter: Chapter 10: Fatma Abu Haty Channel Recipes
fah-703.culturalNotes: Use different fillings as you like. The dough keeps in the fridge for two days.

instructions.1: Mix the sugar, yeast and salt in a bowl.
instructions.2: Add the milk powder, oil, 2 cups of warm water and the egg whites and mix well.
instructions.3: Add the sifted pastry flour, baking powder and vinegar. Knead for 10 minutes.
instructions.4: Add the melted butter at the end and knead 2 more minutes.
instructions.5: Cover and prove for half an hour.
instructions.6: Dice the coloured peppers; slice the onion into wings.
instructions.7: Fry the sausages, peppers and onion, add the ketchup and hot sauce, stir and take off.
instructions.8: Dice coloured peppers; mince the red onion finely.
instructions.9: Add the drained tuna, corn, mayonnaise, hot sauce, mustard, salt and vinegar and mix.
instructions.10: Dice the peppers, pickles and cold cuts or roast beef.
instructions.11: Add mayonnaise, ketchup, a pinch of paprika, chilli, onion powder and garlic powder and mix.
instructions.12: Cut the dough small and weigh each piece at 25–30 g.
instructions.13: Fill each piece, seal and set on an oiled tray.
instructions.14: Cover with plastic and prove for half an hour.
instructions.15: Mix the egg wash from the yolks, milk and vanilla and brush the buns.
instructions.16: Bake at the highest heat until golden.
instructions.17: Stuff with the fillings. Serve hot.

fah-704.title: Tortilla Bread
fah-704.chapter: Chapter 10: Fatma Abu Haty Channel Recipes
fah-704.culturalNotes: Freeze them in bags. Use them for all kinds of sandwiches.

instructions.1: Mix the flour and salt in a bowl.
instructions.2: Add the oil and mix well.
instructions.3: Add the hot water gradually until the dough gathers.
instructions.4: Knead a minute or two until cohesive.
instructions.5: Cut into 15 small pieces and ball them.
instructions.6: Flour the balls and cover with plastic.
instructions.7: Roll each into a thin flatbread with flour.
instructions.8: Trim the edges with a knife.
instructions.9: Heat a pan over medium and lay in a bread.
instructions.10: Flip when the colour changes.
instructions.11: Take off and cover.
instructions.12: Repeat for all the breads.

fah-705.title: No-Knead Fasting Bread
fah-705.chapter: Chapter 10: Fatma Abu Haty Channel Recipes
fah-705.culturalNotes: Works sweet or savory. Keeps in an airtight container for two days.

instructions.1: Blend the warm water with the salt, yeast, sugar and baking powder.
instructions.2: Add the semolina and blend for 5 minutes until smooth.
instructions.3: Cover and prove in a warm place for 15 minutes.
instructions.4: Heat a pan over medium and oil it.
instructions.5: Pour in the batter and cover until the top sets.
instructions.6: Flip until golden on the other side.
instructions.7: Brush with butter while hot if you like.

fah-706.title: No-Oven Potato Pies
fah-706.chapter: Chapter 10: Fatma Abu Haty Channel Recipes
fah-706.culturalNotes: Add cooked chicken cubes, basturma or anything else. Serve hot or cold.

instructions.1: Mix the warm water, yeast, flour, sugar and oil in a large bowl.
instructions.2: Knead until like damp sand.
instructions.3: Add warm water gradually until a soft dough forms.
instructions.4: Knead for at least 10 minutes.
instructions.5: Cover with film and a clean towel and prove for an hour in a warm place.
instructions.6: Separately, fry the chopped onion in 2 spoons of oil until golden.
instructions.7: Add the paprika, black pepper and salt and mix well.
instructions.8: Add the mashed potatoes and mixed cheese and combine.
instructions.9: Cut the dough into small balls and roll each with a fork.
instructions.10: Put filling in the centre of each pie and seal well.
instructions.11: Shape as you like (half-moon or round).
instructions.12: Heat oil in a pan over medium and fry the pies.
instructions.13: Turn until golden on both sides.
instructions.14: Drain on kitchen paper.

fah-707.title: Pizza Pies
fah-707.chapter: Chapter 10: Fatma Abu Haty Channel Recipes
fah-707.culturalNotes: Freeze in plastic bags. Reheat 5–7 minutes in the oven.

instructions.1: Dissolve the yeast and sugar in a cup of warm milk for 5 minutes.
instructions.2: Mix the sifted flour and salt in a large bowl.
instructions.3: Add the yeast-milk mix and knead well.
instructions.4: Add the egg white, the quarter cup of oil and the vinegar and mix.
instructions.5: Add warm water gradually for a soft, elastic dough.
instructions.6: Rest in a warm place until doubled.
instructions.7: Cut into small balls; oil a cup.
instructions.8: Press each ball into the cup to form a dish.
instructions.9: Add your favourite filling (peppers, tomato, olives, cheese) in the centre.
instructions.10: Make the wash from the yolk, 2 spoons of milk, a pinch of instant coffee and a teaspoon of sugar.
instructions.11: Brush the tops and sprinkle sesame to taste.
instructions.12: Bake at 180°C for 10–15 minutes until golden.

fah-708.title: Fried Cheese Pies
fah-708.chapter: Chapter 10: Fatma Abu Haty Channel Recipes
fah-708.culturalNotes: Change the filling — cheddar, Roumy or spiced meat. The pies don't soak up much oil if fried right.

instructions.1: Mix the flour, sugar and salt in a deep bowl.
instructions.2: Add the vinegar and yogurt, then water gradually until soft and non-sticky.
instructions.3: Knead well for 5 minutes, cover and rest 10.
instructions.4: Divide into equal small balls.
instructions.5: Cover with a clean towel and rest 10 minutes.
instructions.6: Roll each ball on a floured board.
instructions.7: Put the baramily-and-cream-cheese filling in the centre and seal the edges.
instructions.8: Cut with a pizza cutter or crimper.
instructions.9: Fry in medium-hot oil until golden on both sides.
instructions.10: Drain on paper.

fah-709.title: Halloumi Pies
fah-709.chapter: Chapter 10: Fatma Abu Haty Channel Recipes
fah-709.culturalNotes: Any cheese works. Serve with tea or coffee as a snack.

instructions.1: Mix the flour, yeast and salt in a large bowl.
instructions.2: Add the yogurt, vinegar and oil and mix well.
instructions.3: Add the warm milk gradually and knead until soft and non-sticky.
instructions.4: Rest in a warm place for 10 minutes.
instructions.5: Cut into small balls and rest again.
instructions.6: Cube the halloumi.
instructions.7: Shape each ball into a disc with a cheese cube in the centre.
instructions.8: Seal well and arrange on an oiled tray.
instructions.9: Brush with the egg-milk-coffee-sugar wash.
instructions.10: Bake at 220°C.
instructions.11: Bake for 10 minutes until golden.
instructions.12: Flip for 5 more minutes to brown the other side.

fah-710.title: Tea Pies with Baramily Cheese
fah-710.chapter: Chapter 10: Fatma Abu Haty Channel Recipes
fah-710.culturalNotes: Freeze in plastic bags; reheat in the microwave or oven.

instructions.1: Mix the milk, oil, water, sugar, yeast and vinegar in a bowl.
instructions.2: Rest for 15 minutes to activate the yeast.
instructions.3: Add the flour, salt and vinegar and mix into a soft smooth dough.
instructions.4: Knead for at least 10 minutes.
instructions.5: Cover with plastic and a clean towel and prove for an hour.
instructions.6: Cut into lemon-sized balls.
instructions.7: Roll each thin and put the baramily filling in the centre.
instructions.8: Cut strips and wrap them around.
instructions.9: Arrange on an oiled or lined tray.
instructions.10: Mix the glaze from the coffee, milk powder, sugar and water.
instructions.11: Brush the tops with the glaze.
instructions.12: Bake in a very hot oven for 20 minutes until golden.
instructions.13: Cool slightly before serving.

fah-711.title: Rose Pies
fah-711.chapter: Chapter 10: Fatma Abu Haty Channel Recipes
fah-711.culturalNotes: Freeze once cooled. Serve with tea at breakfast or in kids' lunchboxes.

instructions.1: Mix the flour, milk powder, sugar, yeast and salt in a bowl.
instructions.2: Add warm water gradually, kneading until soft and non-sticky.
instructions.3: Add the oil and knead at least 10 minutes.
instructions.4: Oil a bowl, set the dough in, cover with plastic and a towel and prove until doubled.
instructions.5: Cut into equal balls (large-lemon size).
instructions.6: Roll each and cut into 4 parts, keeping the middle intact.
instructions.7: Put the cheddar-and-half-olive filling in the centre and close as shown.
instructions.8: Arrange on an oiled tray, cover and prove again.
instructions.9: Brush with the egg-vinegar mix.
instructions.10: Bake in a hot oven until cooked.
instructions.11: Cover straight out of the oven to keep them soft.

fah-712.title: Flaky Pâté & Croissants
fah-712.chapter: Chapter 10: Fatma Abu Haty Channel Recipes
fah-712.culturalNotes: The same dough makes cinnamon rolls and donuts. Keeps in the fridge up to 24 hours.

instructions.1: Make the improver: mix half a cup of flour, a tablespoon of baking powder, a cup of yogurt, a tablespoon of honey and a quarter cup of vinegar until it rises.
instructions.2: Make the dough: mix a kilo of flour, the yeast, milk powder and salt. Add the improver and knead, adding water gradually until it comes together.
instructions.3: Add the 2 eggs and knead at least 10 minutes until elastic.
instructions.4: Add a quarter cup each of butter and oil and knead 10 more minutes.
instructions.5: Cover and prove for two hours in a warm place.
instructions.6: Cut into balls of about 100 g.
instructions.7: Roll each, dot with a teaspoon of butter, dust with flour and roll up.
instructions.8: Repeat for all balls.
instructions.9: Cover and rest for 10 minutes.
instructions.10: For pâté: roll out, add baramily and roll up.
instructions.11: Set on an oiled tray.
instructions.12: For croissants: roll out, roll one side over and roll up.
instructions.13: Set on an oiled tray.
instructions.14: For danish: roll and spiral.
instructions.15: Cover and prove for 30 minutes.
instructions.16: Make the wash: egg whites, 2 spoons of milk and a pinch of instant coffee.
instructions.17: Brush the pastries and add nigella or sesame to taste.
instructions.18: Bake at 180°C for 20–25 minutes until golden.
instructions.19: Brush the danish with apricot jam.

fah-713.title: Potato & Egg Pies
fah-713.chapter: Chapter 10: Fatma Abu Haty Channel Recipes
fah-713.culturalNotes: A date filling — black dates, toasted sesame and butter — works too. Keeps in the fridge for up to 3 days.

instructions.1: Mix the flour, baking powder and salt in a bowl.
instructions.2: Add the oil and water and knead until cohesive.
instructions.3: Cover and rest for 15 minutes.
instructions.4: Cut into an even number of small balls.
instructions.5: Roll pairs of balls, put the filling in the centre and seal.
instructions.6: Make the filling: mash the boiled potatoes with the chopped boiled egg, parsley, salt, pepper and spices.
instructions.7: Fry in a little oil until golden on both sides.
instructions.8: Serve hot.

fah-714.title: Turkish Pies with Cheese Soak
fah-714.chapter: Chapter 10: Fatma Abu Haty Channel Recipes
fah-714.culturalNotes: Use good active yeast. Fill with mashed potato or parsley instead. Keeps in the fridge two days or freeze longer.

instructions.1: Mix the flour and baking powder in a large bowl.
instructions.2: Separately, mix the warm water, warm milk, oil, yeast, sugar and salt.
instructions.3: Add the liquids to the flour and mix well.
instructions.4: Knead at least 10 minutes until smooth, soft and non-sticky.
instructions.5: Cover with plastic and prove for an hour until doubled.
instructions.6: Cut into balls a bit larger than a lemon.
instructions.7: Stuff each with cream cheese and seal.
instructions.8: Dust a tray with flour and space the pies on it.
instructions.9: Prove again for 15 minutes.
instructions.10: Make the soak from milk and cream cheese, mixed well.
instructions.11: Soak the pies with it.
instructions.12: Brush with the egg-Nescafé-vinegar mix.
instructions.13: Bake at 220°C.
instructions.14: Bake for 15 minutes until golden.
instructions.15: Cover with a warm towel for 5 minutes out of the oven.

fah-715.title: Flaky Turkish Pies
fah-715.chapter: Chapter 10: Fatma Abu Haty Channel Recipes
fah-715.culturalNotes: Keeps a long time in the freezer. Reheat a minute in the microwave or oven.

instructions.1: Mix the warm water and milk with the sugar and yeast.
instructions.2: Leave 10–15 minutes for the yeast to foam.
instructions.3: Add the flour, oil and salt and knead at least 10 minutes.
instructions.4: Cover and prove in a warm place until doubled.
instructions.5: Cut into 14 equal balls and cover.
instructions.6: Roll each very thin with flour.
instructions.7: Brush with butter, add the cheese-and-olive filling and roll up.
instructions.8: Roll the log thinner and coil it, sealing the end.
instructions.9: Arrange on an oiled tray and prove again.
instructions.10: Brush with the yolk-vinegar mix.
instructions.11: Bake at 220°C for 15 minutes until golden.
instructions.12: Cover with a clean towel to keep them moist.
instructions.13: Once cold, freeze in plastic bags.

fah-716.title: Russian Meat Pies
fah-716.chapter: Chapter 10: Fatma Abu Haty Channel Recipes
fah-716.culturalNotes: The dough should be flaky and soft when rolled. Change the filling as you like.

instructions.1: Mix the flour, yeast, sugar and salt in a bowl.
instructions.2: Add water gradually and knead 10 minutes until soft and non-sticky.
instructions.3: Set in an oiled bowl, cover and prove in a warm place for 30 minutes.
instructions.4: Separately, mix the mince with the onion, tomato, chilli, bell pepper and spices.
instructions.5: Cut the dough into 12 equal balls.
instructions.6: Roll each on a butter-oiled surface and put the meat filling in the centre.
instructions.7: Roll the dough around the filling in a spiral, tucking the end under.
instructions.8: Arrange on an oiled tray and rest 30 minutes.
instructions.9: Bake at 200°C for 20–25 minutes until golden.

fah-717.title: Quick Cheese Pies
fah-717.chapter: Chapter 10: Fatma Abu Haty Channel Recipes
fah-717.culturalNotes: Freeze once completely cooled. Thaw a little and rebake when needed.

instructions.1: Mix a cup of flour with the yeast and sugar in a bowl.
instructions.2: Add the warm water and mix until combined.
instructions.3: Cover and rest in a warm place 15 minutes until doubled.
instructions.4: Add a cup and a half of flour and the salt and mix into a smooth dough.
instructions.5: Knead at least 10 minutes.
instructions.6: Cover and prove for 15 minutes.
instructions.7: Cut into 8 equal balls.
instructions.8: Stuff with the mixed cheese and seal the edges well.
instructions.9: Brush with the thyme-garlic butter.
instructions.10: Arrange on an oiled tray and bake on high until golden.
instructions.11: Brush with hot butter out of the oven.
instructions.12: Serve hot with tea or mint.

fah-718.title: Cottony Cheese Pies
fah-718.chapter: Chapter 10: Fatma Abu Haty Channel Recipes
fah-718.culturalNotes: Test the yeast first — a spoon of yeast in warm water with half a spoon of sugar for 10 minutes. If it foams up, it's good.

instructions.1: Mix the flour with the yeast, sugar, salt and vinegar in a large bowl.
instructions.2: Add the yogurt, warm milk, egg and oil gradually while stirring.
instructions.3: Knead until soft and slightly tacky.
instructions.4: Cover and prove for 30 minutes or until doubled.
instructions.5: Cut into small balls and roll each oval.
instructions.6: Butter each oval and put a spoon of filling in the centre.
instructions.7: Seal well and roll up.
instructions.8: Set seam-down on an oiled or lined tray.
instructions.9: Prove for 10 minutes.
instructions.10: Brush with the egg-milk-vinegar wash.
instructions.11: Bake at 220°C for 10 minutes until golden.
instructions.12: Brush with butter and a pinch of thyme out of the oven.
instructions.13: Serve hot with mint tea.

fah-719.title: Cottony Pies with Assorted Fillings
fah-719.chapter: Chapter 10: Fatma Abu Haty Channel Recipes
fah-719.culturalNotes: Any filling — cheese with basturma, mince or vegetables — but it must be cooked and dry so it doesn't leak. Serve at breakfast or dinner.

instructions.1: Mix the flour, milk powder, sugar, yeast and salt in a large bowl.
instructions.2: Add the vinegar, oil and warm water gradually and knead until cohesive.
instructions.3: Cover and prove for 30 minutes or until doubled.
instructions.4: Cut into small balls and roll each out.
instructions.5: Add filling in the centre and seal the edges tight.
instructions.6: Set on an oiled or silicone-lined tray.
instructions.7: Prove again for 15 minutes.
instructions.8: Brush with the milk-powder-Nescafé-sugar-water glaze.
instructions.9: Put a nigella pinch and a bit of butter or an olive in the centre of each.
instructions.10: Bake at 220°C for 20 minutes or until golden.
instructions.11: Serve hot.

fah-720.title: Chicken-Stuffed Pies
fah-720.chapter: Chapter 10: Fatma Abu Haty Channel Recipes
fah-720.culturalNotes: Tuna or cheese fillings work too. Keeps in the fridge two days or freeze longer.

instructions.1: Mix the flour, yeast, sugar and salt in a large bowl.
instructions.2: Add the yogurt and warm water and knead until combined.
instructions.3: Knead 5 minutes, add the oil and knead 5 more.
instructions.4: Cover with plastic and prove for an hour.
instructions.5: Separately, fry the onion in hot oil until golden.
instructions.6: Add the chopped chicken and spices and cook through.
instructions.7: Add the yogurt, mayonnaise and ketchup and mix well.
instructions.8: Let the filling cool slightly.
instructions.9: Cut the dough into 12 equal balls.
instructions.10: Roll each thin into a disc.
instructions.11: Spoon filling into each and seal to shape.
instructions.12: Oil a tray and fry the pies until golden on both sides.
instructions.13: Serve hot.

fah-721.title: Puffed Cheese Pies
fah-721.chapter: Chapter 10: Fatma Abu Haty Channel Recipes
fah-721.culturalNotes: Serve with milk tea for breakfast or dinner. Any filling works as long as it's cooked.

instructions.1: Mix the white flour, semolina and salt in a bowl.
instructions.2: Add the oil and mix well.
instructions.3: Add warm water gradually until the dough comes together.
instructions.4: Knead a few minutes until cohesive.
instructions.5: Cut into large-lemon-sized balls.
instructions.6: Wrap and rest for 10 minutes.
instructions.7: Roll each very thin with flour.
instructions.8: Brush the surface with melted butter.
instructions.9: Fold the top and bottom edges and put the filling in the centre.
instructions.10: Seal the edges well.
instructions.11: Heat a pan over medium with a little oil.
instructions.12: Cook the pies, turning until puffed and golden on both sides.

fah-722.title: Quick Flaky Pies
fah-722.chapter: Chapter 10: Fatma Abu Haty Channel Recipes
fah-722.culturalNotes: The butter should be soft or melted for brushing, and roll the dough very thin for a flaky result.

instructions.1: Mix the milk, oil, vanilla, vinegar, sugar and egg in a bowl.
instructions.2: Add the flour and salt gradually, mixing until cohesive.
instructions.3: Knead at least 10 minutes until elastic and soft.
instructions.4: Set in an oiled bowl, cover with plastic and a towel and prove for an hour.
instructions.5: Roll out into a very thin rectangle.
instructions.6: Brush with the soft or melted butter.
instructions.7: Roll up and cut into equal pieces.
instructions.8: Split each piece from the middle and open the ends.
instructions.9: Arrange on an oiled tray.
instructions.10: Prove again for 15 minutes.
instructions.11: Brush with the egg-milk-vinegar-sugar wash.
instructions.12: Bake at 220°C for 20 minutes until golden.
instructions.13: Serve hot with tea, cheese or jam.

fah-723.title: Fluffy Cheese & Olive Pies
fah-723.chapter: Chapter 10: Fatma Abu Haty Channel Recipes
fah-723.culturalNotes: Any cheese works. Serve with mint tea or any drink.

instructions.1: Mix the flour, milk powder, baking powder, salt, sugar and yeast in a large bowl.
instructions.2: Add the oil and warm water gradually, kneading until cohesive and soft.
instructions.3: Cover and prove for an hour until doubled.
instructions.4: Cut into small balls and roll each thin.
instructions.5: Fill with cheddar, grated cheese, double cream and green olives and seal well.
instructions.6: Lightly oil the tray and space the pies on it.
instructions.7: Prove again for 15 minutes.
instructions.8: Beat the egg with the vinegar and brush the pies.
instructions.9: Bake at 200°C for 15–20 minutes until golden.
instructions.10: Sprinkle sesame on before baking.

fah-724.title: Turkish Pide Pies
fah-724.chapter: Chapter 10: Fatma Abu Haty Channel Recipes
fah-724.culturalNotes: Add thyme or any spices you like. Keeps in the fridge two days or freeze longer.

instructions.1: Make the poolish: mix a cup of flour, a cup of water and the yeast. Cover and refrigerate 4–5 hours or overnight.
instructions.2: Mix the poolish with the 2 cups of flour, sugar, salt and third cup of water. Knead into a soft dough.
instructions.3: Add the olive oil and knead again until smooth.
instructions.4: Cover and prove until doubled.
instructions.5: Prepare the filling: cube the sausages and fry in a spoon of oil for 2–3 minutes. Cool.
instructions.6: Shape the pies: roll the dough on a floured surface, put the sausage-and-cheese filling in the centre and seal tight.
instructions.7: Set on an oiled tray and rest briefly.
instructions.8: Bake at 200°C for 10–15 minutes until golden.
instructions.9: Drizzle a little olive oil on top for shine and taste.

fah-725.title: Turkish Pocket Pies
fah-725.chapter: Chapter 10: Fatma Abu Haty Channel Recipes
fah-725.culturalNotes: Freeze for up to a month. Serve with your favourite fillings.

instructions.1: Mix the yeast and half the sugar in warm water for 5 minutes.
instructions.2: Add the milk, oil, egg, vinegar and remaining sugar and stir well.
instructions.3: Add the flour, baking powder and salt and knead until cohesive.
instructions.4: Cover and prove for 30 minutes.
instructions.5: Cut into 20–24 pieces and ball them.
instructions.6: Cover and rest for 5 minutes.
instructions.7: Roll each on the butter-oiled marble until thin.
instructions.8: Brush the tops, fold in half twice.
instructions.9: Arrange on an oiled tray and prove.
instructions.10: Brush with the milk-powder-sugar-Nescafé-water glaze.
instructions.11: Sprinkle sesame and nigella.
instructions.12: Bake at 200°C for 10 minutes until golden.
instructions.13: Cover with a towel out of the oven and freeze in bags once cooled.

fah-726.title: Happiness Pies with Assorted Fillings
fah-726.chapter: Chapter 10: Fatma Abu Haty Channel Recipes
fah-726.culturalNotes: Cheese or mince fillings work too. Keeps in the fridge for two days.

instructions.1: Mix the flour, baking powder and salt in a bowl.
instructions.2: Add the oil and water and knead until cohesive.
instructions.3: Cover and rest for 15 minutes.
instructions.4: Cut into an even number of small balls.
instructions.5: Roll pairs, fill the centre and seal.
instructions.6: Filling one: mash the boiled potatoes with the boiled egg, salt, spices, pepper and parsley.
instructions.7: Filling two: wash the dates, add the ghee and toasted sesame and cook until the moisture dries.
instructions.8: Fry in a little oil until golden on both sides.
instructions.9: Serve hot.

fah-727.title: Pan Pies
fah-727.chapter: Chapter 10: Fatma Abu Haty Channel Recipes
fah-727.culturalNotes: Freeze once cooled. Shape round or square as you like.

instructions.1: Mix the flour with the baking powder and salt in a bowl.
instructions.2: Separately, mix the warm water, warm milk, sugar and yeast and leave 5 minutes to activate.
instructions.3: Add the liquids to the flour with the vinegar, yogurt and half cup of oil. Knead until cohesive.
instructions.4: Rest for half an hour.
instructions.5: Shape egg-sized balls.
instructions.6: Roll each to about half a centimetre.
instructions.7: Fill with cheese, olives, leftover chicken or anything you like.
instructions.8: Seal and crimp the edges with a fork.
instructions.9: Rest for 10 minutes.
instructions.10: Heat a pan over medium and oil lightly.
instructions.11: Cook 4 minutes per side until golden.
instructions.12: Serve hot.

fah-728.title: Amazing Pan Pies
fah-728.chapter: Chapter 10: Fatma Abu Haty Channel Recipes
fah-728.culturalNotes: Fill with cheese, olives, spiced chicken, Nutella or a sugar-cinnamon-cocoa mix. Freeze once cooled.

instructions.1: Mix the flour with the baking powder and salt in a bowl.
instructions.2: Separately, mix the warm water and warm milk with the sugar and yeast and leave 5 minutes to activate.
instructions.3: Add the liquids to the flour and knead well.
instructions.4: Add the yogurt, vinegar and cup of oil and knead until smooth.
instructions.5: Rest for half an hour.
instructions.6: Shape small balls and rest for 10 minutes.
instructions.7: Roll each to half a centimetre.
instructions.8: Fill with cheese or your favourite fillings.
instructions.9: Seal and crimp well with a fork.
instructions.10: Heat a pan over medium and oil lightly.
instructions.11: Fry for 4 minutes until golden.
instructions.12: Serve hot.

fah-729.title: Cheese & Cream Pies
fah-729.chapter: Chapter 10: Fatma Abu Haty Channel Recipes
fah-729.culturalNotes: Shape them any size. Salt and pepper on top before baking adds flavour. Keeps in the fridge two days or freeze longer.

instructions.1: Mix the flour with the sugar, yeast and salt in a large bowl.
instructions.2: Add the milk gradually, mixing until a dough forms.
instructions.3: Add the butter and oil and knead for 7 minutes until soft and non-sticky.
instructions.4: Cover and prove for an hour in a warm place.
instructions.5: Divide into 6 pieces and roll each to about 4 mm.
instructions.6: Put a spoon of cream cheese in the centre and fold the edges over.
instructions.7: Set on an oiled or lined tray.
instructions.8: Brush with beaten egg and bake at 220°C for 15–20 minutes until golden.
instructions.9: Serve hot with ashta and honey or jam.

fah-730.title: Sausage Pies
fah-730.chapter: Chapter 10: Fatma Abu Haty Channel Recipes
fah-730.culturalNotes: Add tomato and sweet-pepper slices on top before the cheese melts for a nice look.

instructions.1: Mix the flour, sugar, salt and yeast in a bowl.
instructions.2: Add warm water gradually and knead until soft and cohesive.
instructions.3: Add the half cup of oil and mix for 10 minutes.
instructions.4: Cover and prove for 30 minutes until doubled.
instructions.5: Separately, mix the onions, chilli, green pepper, garlic and tomato.
instructions.6: Add the mince, liyya, tahini and spices and knead well.
instructions.7: Repeat for the sausage and chicken fillings.
instructions.8: Cut the dough into small balls and roll out.
instructions.9: Fill each pie and seal well.
instructions.10: Arrange on an oiled tray and cook over medium heat for 10 minutes.
instructions.11: Top with mixed cheese before taking them out.
instructions.12: Serve hot with the red-onion salad.

fah-731.title: Chicken Pies
fah-731.chapter: Chapter 10: Fatma Abu Haty Channel Recipes
fah-731.culturalNotes: Serve with a red-onion, parsley and tomato salad. Keeps in the fridge two days or freeze longer.

instructions.1: Mix the flour, sugar, yeast and salt in a large bowl.
instructions.2: Add warm water gradually and knead until soft and cohesive.
instructions.3: Add the half cup of oil and mix for 10 minutes.
instructions.4: Cover and prove for 30 minutes until doubled.
instructions.5: Separately, mix the onions, chilli, green pepper, yellow pepper, garlic and tomato.
instructions.6: Add the mince, tahini, salt and spices and knead well.
instructions.7: Repeat for the sausage and chicken fillings with their own spices.
instructions.8: Cut the dough into small balls and roll out.
instructions.9: Fill and seal well.
instructions.10: Arrange on an oiled tray and bake on high for 10 minutes.
instructions.11: Add the cheese on top 2 minutes before the end.

fah-732.title: Coffee-Glazed Buns
fah-732.chapter: Chapter 10: Fatma Abu Haty Channel Recipes
fah-732.culturalNotes: Keeps in a sealed plastic bag for up to 3 days. Serve with karak tea.

instructions.1: Mix the flour, sugar, yeast, baking powder and salt in a large bowl.
instructions.2: Add the eggs, milk and warm water gradually and knead for 10 minutes.
instructions.3: Add the butter gradually and knead 10 more minutes.
instructions.4: Cover with a clean towel and prove for an hour.
instructions.5: Meanwhile, mix the icing sugar, melted butter, vanilla, instant coffee, flour and cornflour for the topping.
instructions.6: Divide the proved dough into small balls (about 60 g each).
instructions.7: Roll each into a disc, put a small piece of butter in the centre and fold the edges.
instructions.8: Cover and rest for 10 minutes.
instructions.9: Set on an oiled tray and prove 10 more minutes in a warm oven.
instructions.10: Bake at 200°C for 15–20 minutes until golden.
instructions.11: Serve with caramel sauce.

fah-733.title: Kunafa Pan Pies
fah-733.chapter: Chapter 10: Fatma Abu Haty Channel Recipes
fah-733.culturalNotes: Cinnamon in the filling adds a nice touch. Keeps in the fridge for two days.

instructions.1: Mix the flour with the sugar and salt in a bowl.
instructions.2: Add water gradually, stirring, for a light batter.
instructions.3: Rest for 10 minutes.
instructions.4: Heat a pan over medium and add 2 drops of oil.
instructions.5: Pour in a little batter and let it set.
instructions.6: Flip until browned on the other side.
instructions.7: Put toasted kunafa, butter, sugar and nuts on half the pie.
instructions.8: Fold the other half over and press lightly.
instructions.9: Brown on both sides until golden.
instructions.10: Serve hot.

fah-734.title: Meat Pies
fah-734.chapter: Chapter 10: Fatma Abu Haty Channel Recipes
fah-734.culturalNotes: Serve with a red-onion, parsley and tomato salad. Keeps in the fridge two days or freeze longer.

instructions.1: In the mixer, combine the 2 kilos of flour with 2 tablespoons of sugar, a teaspoon of salt and 2 tablespoons of yeast.
instructions.2: Add warm water gradually until a soft dough forms.
instructions.3: Add the half cup of oil and mix for 10 minutes.
instructions.4: Set in a large oiled dish, turn to coat, cover and prove for 30 minutes.
instructions.5: Meat filling: mix half a kilo of onions, a hot pepper, 2 sweet peppers, 6–7 garlic cloves and 2 tomatoes.
instructions.6: Add the mince, a tablespoon of tahini, salt, pepper and meat spices and mix well.
instructions.7: Sausage filling: mix half a kilo of onions, a hot pepper, 2 sweet peppers, the baladi sausage, salt, cumin and dried coriander.
instructions.8: Chicken filling: mix half a kilo of onions, the coloured peppers, 6 garlic cloves, the chicken breast, salt, smoked paprika, black pepper and chicken spices.
instructions.9: Cut the dough into small-orange-sized balls, cover and rest for 5 minutes.
instructions.10: Roll each on a dusting of flour, fill the centre and seal well.
instructions.11: Arrange on an oiled tray and bake on high for 10 minutes.
instructions.12: Top with cheese and return to the oven until it melts.

fah-735.title: Sweet & Savory Pies
fah-735.chapter: Chapter 10: Fatma Abu Haty Channel Recipes
fah-735.culturalNotes: The dough should be elastic and soft before shaping. A very hot oven gives flaky, tender pies.

instructions.1: Mix the flour, salt and sugar in a bowl.
instructions.2: Add water gradually until cohesive.
instructions.3: Knead for 10 minutes until elastic and soft.
instructions.4: Cut into 12 pieces and ball them.
instructions.5: Set in an oiled dish covered with plastic for an hour.
instructions.6: Roll each ball into a rectangle and halve it.
instructions.7: Put the meat-and-cheese filling on one half and fold.
instructions.8: Repeat for all the balls.
instructions.9: Set on an unoiled tray in a hot oven.
instructions.10: Bake until golden.
instructions.11: For the sweet pies, mix the milk with custard, vanilla and raisins.
instructions.12: Roll the dough, fill and fold.
instructions.13: Bake until golden.
instructions.14: Brush with white honey or thick syrup out of the oven.
instructions.15: Dust the sweet pies with icing sugar.

fah-736.title: Sham el-Nessim Pies (Mangauna)
fah-736.chapter: Chapter 10: Fatma Abu Haty Channel Recipes
fah-736.culturalNotes: Shape them however you like. Brush with white honey or jam after baking.

instructions.1: Mix the yeast with a little warm milk and a spoon of sugar and leave to activate.
instructions.2: Mix the flour with the baking powder, salt and milk powder in a bowl.
instructions.3: Add the ghee and oil and mix until like sand grains.
instructions.4: Add the egg, a pinch of vanilla, the vinegar, the rest of the sugar and the rest of the warm milk and knead well.
instructions.5: Add the yogurt or laban and knead 7–10 minutes until soft.
instructions.6: Cover and prove for one to two hours.
instructions.7: Punch out the air, cover and prove again for an hour.
instructions.8: Cut small and shape as you like (braids or spirals).
instructions.9: Set on an oiled tray and prove for 10 minutes.
instructions.10: Brush with the milk-powder-Nescafé-sugar-water glaze.
instructions.11: Bake at 200°C until golden.
instructions.12: Switch off the bottom heat and use the fan for colour on top.
instructions.13: Leave 7–10 minutes until fluffy and golden.

fah-737.title: Pizza Triangles with Amazing Dough
fah-737.chapter: Chapter 10: Fatma Abu Haty Channel Recipes
fah-737.culturalNotes: Any cheeses and fillings work. Serve with a warm drink for a full meal.

instructions.1: Mix the flour with the yeast, sugar and salt in a bowl.
instructions.2: Add the egg and cream gradually and mix well.
instructions.3: Add warm water gradually and knead until cohesive.
instructions.4: Prove in a warm place for an hour.
instructions.5: Cut into large-egg-sized balls.
instructions.6: Roll each into a thin disc.
instructions.7: Cut the disc into strips, stopping short of the edges.
instructions.8: Put the filling in the centre and fold the strips into a triangle.
instructions.9: Set on an oiled or lined tray.
instructions.10: Prove again for 15 minutes.
instructions.11: Brush with the egg-milk wash.
instructions.12: Sprinkle sesame to taste.
instructions.13: Bake at 220°C for 20 minutes.
instructions.14: Cool slightly before serving.

fah-738.title: Cheese & Roumy Stuffed Pies
fah-738.chapter: Chapter 10: Fatma Abu Haty Channel Recipes
fah-738.culturalNotes: Freeze in bags once cooled and reheat in the oven or microwave. Change the filling as you like.

instructions.1: Mix the salt, sugar and yeast into the flour.
instructions.2: Add the yogurt and oil and mix well.
instructions.3: Add warm water gradually until a dough forms.
instructions.4: Knead at least 10 minutes until elastic and soft.
instructions.5: Cover with plastic and a clean towel and prove until doubled.
instructions.6: Fill with cheese, Roumy and olives.
instructions.7: Cut into small balls and roll out.
instructions.8: Fill the centre and seal tight.
instructions.9: Set on an oiled or lined tray.
instructions.10: Brush the tops with the milk-powder-water-sugar-Nescafé glaze.
instructions.11: Bake on the bottom shelf for 10–15 minutes until golden.
instructions.12: Snip the edges with scissors for a pretty shape.

fah-739.title: Fried Chicken & Cheese Pies
fah-739.chapter: Chapter 10: Fatma Abu Haty Channel Recipes
fah-739.culturalNotes: Change the filling — mince, or just cheese with peppers and parsley. Or finish in the oven after browning the base.

instructions.1: Mix the yeast, sugar and salt in the warm milk and leave 10 minutes to activate.
instructions.2: Add the oil and stir well.
instructions.3: Add the flour gradually and knead until soft and non-sticky.
instructions.4: Cover and prove for 30 minutes in a warm place.
instructions.5: Separately, fry the onion and coloured peppers in a little oil until translucent.
instructions.6: Add the chicken pieces and cook through.
instructions.7: Add the salt, pepper, thyme, cinnamon and hot sauce or ketchup and mix well.
instructions.8: Let the filling cool.
instructions.9: Cut the dough into small pieces and roll each with a fork.
instructions.10: Spoon filling into each piece and seal to shape.
instructions.11: Fry in medium-hot oil until golden on both sides.
instructions.12: Serve hot.

fah-740.title: Eastern Feteer
fah-740.chapter: Chapter 10: Fatma Abu Haty Channel Recipes
fah-740.culturalNotes: The dough must rest well before rolling, and use oil to stop sticking. Serve plain or with your favourite fillings.

instructions.1: Mix a kilo of flour with a pinch each of salt and sugar in a bowl.
instructions.2: Add water gradually until a cohesive dough forms.
instructions.3: Turn onto a floured surface and knead well.
instructions.4: Divide into small balls of about 100 g.
instructions.5: Dip the balls in oil in a dish and rest for half an hour.
instructions.6: Roll the rested dough until translucent, oiling your hands and the surface.
instructions.7: Spread a spoon of butter on the sheet, cut with a knife and fold simply.
instructions.8: Bake in a hot oven until golden.
instructions.9: Fill with spiced meat, cheese, mozzarella or basturma as you like.
instructions.10: Serve hot with honey or icing sugar.

fah-741.title: No-Oven Meshaltet
fah-741.chapter: Chapter 10: Fatma Abu Haty Channel Recipes
fah-741.culturalNotes: Serve with honey or aged cheese. Keeps in the fridge for two days.

instructions.1: Mix the flour, salt and sugar in a bowl.
instructions.2: Add water gradually and knead until soft and elastic.
instructions.3: Cover and rest for 10 minutes.
instructions.4: Divide into 3 equal balls.
instructions.5: Roll each very thin on a floured surface.
instructions.6: Make the layering mix from the butter, oil, cornflour and baking powder.
instructions.7: Brush the sheet with the layering mix.
instructions.8: Cut it into 4 quarters with a knife.
instructions.9: Fold as shown in the video.
instructions.10: Roll the pie out thin again.
instructions.11: Cook on a medium-hot pan until browned on both sides.
instructions.12: Cover after cooking to keep moist.

fah-742.title: Quick Meshaltet
fah-742.chapter: Chapter 10: Fatma Abu Haty Channel Recipes
fah-742.culturalNotes: Serve with aged cheese or cucumber and honey. Keeps in the fridge for two days.

instructions.1: In a deep dish, mix the ashta, yogurt and baking powder well.
instructions.2: Spread two spoons of ghee in the tray.
instructions.3: Lay a filo sheet in the tray and brush with the mix.
instructions.4: Repeat for every sheet, brushing every sheet or two.
instructions.5: Keep the intact sheets for the bottom, top and middle if some are torn.
instructions.6: Brush the top with the remaining ghee.
instructions.7: Bake at 200°C for 10 minutes until golden.
instructions.8: Cover with foil for 5 minutes to soften.

fah-743.title: Savory Folded Feteer
fah-743.chapter: Chapter 10: Fatma Abu Haty Channel Recipes
fah-743.culturalNotes: Change the filling — meat, chicken, or custard with nuts. Keeps in the fridge two days or freeze longer.

instructions.1: Prepare the filling: dice the cheese, coloured peppers, olives and basturma.
instructions.2: Make the secret mix: combine the ghee, ashta, yogurt and baking powder until smooth.
instructions.3: Lay a filo sheet and brush half with the mix.
instructions.4: Fold the sheet onto itself.
instructions.5: Put the filling on the bare half.
instructions.6: Fold over the filling and seal the edges.
instructions.7: Heat oil in a pan over medium.
instructions.8: Fry until golden on both sides.
instructions.9: Repeat for more pies.
instructions.10: Serve hot.

fah-744.title: Sweet Folded Feteer
fah-744.chapter: Chapter 10: Fatma Abu Haty Channel Recipes
fah-744.culturalNotes: Different fillings work — nuts or dates. Keeps in the fridge for two days.

instructions.1: Prepare the filling: dice the cheese, basturma, olives and coloured peppers.
instructions.2: Filo mix: combine the ghee, ashta, yogurt and baking powder until smooth.
instructions.3: Lay a filo sheet, brush half with the mix and fold the other half over.
instructions.4: Put the filling on the bare half and seal the edges.
instructions.5: Repeat for more pies.
instructions.6: Fry in medium-hot oil until golden on both sides.
instructions.7: For sweet ones: the same steps with a custard-sugar-cinnamon filling, then white honey or icing sugar when serving.

fah-745.title: Abu Haty Pie
fah-745.chapter: Chapter 10: Fatma Abu Haty Channel Recipes
fah-745.culturalNotes: Any cheese and cold cuts in the fridge work. Add your favourite vegetables. Keeps in the fridge up to 24 hours before cooking.

instructions.1: Dice the peppers and tomato, deseeding the tomato.
instructions.2: Add the chopped sausages and basturma to the filling.
instructions.3: Add the diced cheese and mozzarella.
instructions.4: Mix the butter, oil, sugar, salt, yogurt and baking powder for the coating mix.
instructions.5: Dip a filo sheet in the mix and lay it in the tray.
instructions.6: Repeat until the tray is covered.
instructions.7: Put the filling in the centre and fold the corners over.
instructions.8: Set in a pan over medium and cover.
instructions.9: Flip once the bottom is golden.
instructions.10: Cook until the other side is done.

fah-746.title: Date Pie
fah-746.chapter: Chapter 10: Fatma Abu Haty Channel Recipes
fah-746.culturalNotes: Add more sugar to the milk soak if you like, though dates are usually sweet enough.

instructions.1: Sauté the dates with a spoon of butter for 3 minutes.
instructions.2: Pick a good filo and grease the tray with butter and oil.
instructions.3: Lay two sheets in the tray and brush with the butter-oil mix.
instructions.4: Add two more sheets brushed the same way.
instructions.5: Repeat until 4 sheets remain.
instructions.6: Put the sautéed-date filling in the centre.
instructions.7: Add two more brushed sheets.
instructions.8: Close the pie with the remaining sheets, sealing all edges.
instructions.9: Brush with butter and oil.
instructions.10: Bake at about 200°C until light golden (about 10 minutes).
instructions.11: Mix 2 spoons of sugar with a cup of milk and soak the pie.
instructions.12: Return to the oven for 10 more minutes to absorb.
instructions.13: Cool slightly before serving.

fah-747.title: Tasty Cheese Pie
fah-747.chapter: Chapter 10: Fatma Abu Haty Channel Recipes
fah-747.culturalNotes: Add other fillings like a pizza mix. Good for dinner or breakfast.

instructions.1: Mix the flour, sugar, salt and yeast in a bowl.
instructions.2: Add the warm milk, oil and vinegar and mix well.
instructions.3: Knead for 10 minutes until smooth and crease-free.
instructions.4: Cover and prove for half an hour.
instructions.5: Roll into an oiled tray to half a centimetre.
instructions.6: Cut strips about 1.5 cm wide.
instructions.7: Set a plate in the centre and trim the edges around it.
instructions.8: Spread the cream cheese and weave the strips across it.
instructions.9: Brush the edges with egg beaten with milk, black pepper, sugar and vinegar.
instructions.10: Bake on the lower rack for 10 minutes until golden.
instructions.11: Cut and serve hot with tea.

fah-748.title: Filo Pie with Cheese & Basturma
fah-748.chapter: Chapter 10: Fatma Abu Haty Channel Recipes
fah-748.culturalNotes: Serve hot for breakfast, lunch or dinner. Keeps in the fridge for two days.

instructions.1: Grease the tray lightly with ghee.
instructions.2: Lay the filo sheets alternating lengthwise and crosswise, brushing each with ghee.
instructions.3: Mix the milk with the black pepper, salt and oil.
instructions.4: Dip the filo sheets in the mix and arrange in the centre.
instructions.5: Add the filling (cheese, peppers, olives, basturma) in the middle.
instructions.6: Dip extra sheets in the egg mix and lay over the filling.
instructions.7: Finish the top layer with ghee-brushed filo.
instructions.8: Fold the edges in to level the pie.
instructions.9: Brush the top with ghee.
instructions.10: Bake at 200°C for 20 minutes until golden and crisp.

fah-749.title: Garlic & Basil Happiness Pie
fah-749.chapter: Chapter 10: Fatma Abu Haty Channel Recipes
fah-749.culturalNotes: Fresh basil on top before baking adds aroma and taste.

instructions.1: Mix the sugar and yeast in warm water for 10 minutes to activate.
instructions.2: Add the yogurt, baking powder and salt and mix well.
instructions.3: Add the flour gradually, kneading into a soft, elastic dough.
instructions.4: Cover and prove for 30 minutes.
instructions.5: Separately, mash the garlic with oil over low heat until it lightens.
instructions.6: Add the thyme, parsley, butter and salt and mix.
instructions.7: Oil and flour the baking tray.
instructions.8: Spread the dough and spread the garlic sauce on top.
instructions.9: Scatter the grated cheese evenly.
instructions.10: Bake at 200°C for 20 minutes or until golden.
instructions.11: Cut and serve hot with tea or milk tea.

fah-750.title: No-Oven Custard Pie
fah-750.chapter: Chapter 10: Fatma Abu Haty Channel Recipes
fah-750.culturalNotes: Add nuts and fruit — banana, kiwi, apple — when serving. Keeps in the fridge for up to two days.

instructions.1: Make the brush mix: half a cup of melted butter, half a cup of yogurt and a teaspoon of baking powder.
instructions.2: Lay a filo sheet and brush with the mix.
instructions.3: Lay another sheet on top and brush it too.
instructions.4: Put the custard filling in the centre and fold in thirds.
instructions.5: Brush again with the mix.
instructions.6: Heat a pan over medium with a spoon of ghee or oil.
instructions.7: Fry until golden on both sides.
instructions.8: Serve hot with icing sugar and warm milk or honey.

fah-751.title: Pan Filo Pie
fah-751.chapter: Chapter 10: Fatma Abu Haty Channel Recipes
fah-751.culturalNotes: Any cheeses and fillings work. Keeps in the fridge for two days.

instructions.1: Mix half a cup of butter, 2 tablespoons of oil, 3 of yogurt and half a teaspoon of baking powder in a bowl.
instructions.2: Grease a tray with ghee.
instructions.3: Halve a filo sheet and lay one lengthwise and one crosswise.
instructions.4: Brush each sheet with the prepared mix.
instructions.5: Repeat for all the filo.
instructions.6: Put the filling (cheese, peppers, tomato, basturma, egg) in the centre.
instructions.7: Cover with another filo sheet and brush with ghee.
instructions.8: Fold the overhanging edges over the filling.
instructions.9: Brush the top with ghee.
instructions.10: Set in a pan over medium for 4 minutes until browned.
instructions.11: Flip, return to the tray and cover for 2 minutes.
instructions.12: Add half a cup of milk and cover for 2 minutes to absorb.
instructions.13: Cut and serve hot.

fah-752.title: Eastern-Style Pie
fah-752.chapter: Chapter 10: Fatma Abu Haty Channel Recipes
fah-752.culturalNotes: Add other spices like ground coriander or parsley. Keeps in the fridge two days or freeze longer.

instructions.1: Heat a pan with a tablespoon of ghee.
instructions.2: Add the chopped onion and fry until it changes colour.
instructions.3: Add the mince and stir with the onion until it changes colour.
instructions.4: Add the salt, black pepper and green pepper and mix well.
instructions.5: Add the yogurt, baking powder, sugar, quarter cup of oil and half cup of ghee and mix until combined.
instructions.6: Set the layering mix aside.
instructions.7: Grease the tray's base and sides with ghee.
instructions.8: Lay two filo sheets and brush with the mix.
instructions.9: Repeat for all the filo.
instructions.10: Top with the cheese slice.
instructions.11: Fold the edges and brush them with the mix.
instructions.12: Bake at 200°C for 20 minutes until light golden.
instructions.13: Sprinkle a little grated cheese on top.
instructions.14: Return to the oven for 10 minutes until nicely coloured and the cheese melts.
instructions.15: Serve hot.

fah-753.title: Multi-Flavour Pies
fah-753.chapter: Chapter 10: Fatma Abu Haty Channel Recipes
fah-753.culturalNotes: Freeze and reheat when needed. Serve with mint tea for a complete meal.

instructions.1: Mix the flour with the sugar, yeast and salt in a large bowl.
instructions.2: Add the yogurt and warm water gradually and knead until cohesive.
instructions.3: Add the olive oil and knead 10 more minutes until smooth and elastic.
instructions.4: Set in an oiled bowl and prove until doubled.
instructions.5: Heat the oven on high.
instructions.6: Roll onto a tray and put different fillings on different sections.
instructions.7: Cut into squares and bake 5 minutes low then 10 high until golden.
instructions.8: Cool slightly before serving.

fah-754.title: Olive Focaccia
fah-754.chapter: Chapter 10: Fatma Abu Haty Channel Recipes
fah-754.culturalNotes: Serve with cheese and tea for a tasty breakfast. Keeps in the fridge for two days.

instructions.1: Mix the warm water with the sugar, yeast and salt in a bowl.
instructions.2: Add half a cup of flour and the olive oil and mix well.
instructions.3: Cover and rest for 30 minutes until foamy.
instructions.4: Add the 4 cups of flour gradually and knead until cohesive.
instructions.5: Cover and prove for 30 minutes.
instructions.6: On a wet surface, stretch and fold the dough.
instructions.7: Repeat 4 times, covering and resting 30 minutes each time.
instructions.8: Add the olive slices and fold them in.
instructions.9: Cover and rest for 30 minutes.
instructions.10: Refrigerate for 3 hours.
instructions.11: Heat the oven to 200°C.
instructions.12: Oil the tray and set the dough in.
instructions.13: Brush with 2 spoons of oil and a pinch of salt.
instructions.14: Bake until golden.
instructions.15: Until golden top and bottom.

fah-755.title: Chocolate Bows
fah-755.chapter: Chapter 10: Fatma Abu Haty Channel Recipes
fah-755.culturalNotes: Freeze in a plastic bag once cooled. Serve with tea or milk for breakfast or a snack.

instructions.1: Mix the flour with the milk powder, sugar, salt and yeast in a bowl.
instructions.2: Add the yogurt and mix well.
instructions.3: Add warm water gradually until a dough forms.
instructions.4: Add the oil and butter and knead for 10 minutes until soft and cohesive.
instructions.5: Cover with film and a clean towel and prove for an hour.
instructions.6: Cut into egg-or-lemon-sized balls.
instructions.7: Flour the surface and roll each to shape.
instructions.8: Add Nutella on both sides and split the dough in half.
instructions.9: Seal the sides and cut two slits in the middle.
instructions.10: Cover with a towel and rest for 10 minutes.
instructions.11: Brush with the egg-milk-instant-coffee wash.
instructions.12: Sprinkle sugar on top.
instructions.13: Bake at 220°C for 20 minutes until golden.

fah-756.title: Qaraqish (Date Biscuits)
fah-756.chapter: Chapter 10: Fatma Abu Haty Channel Recipes
fah-756.culturalNotes: Make sure the date paste is free of grit. A spoon of butter softens it. Serve with milk tea and cheese for a perfect breakfast.
